"""Terrain chapter of the original saved scientific-report receiving operation.

TokenJunkieLabs. Reads completed native cases and responses, prepares their
ordinary report source, and verifies the original restored typed study.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from model.common import atomic_json, describe_file, read_json, verify_file
from model import terrain_conditioning_report_source as reports
from source_tools import terrain_conditioning as terrain
from source_tools import terrain_conditioning_response as responses

SCHEMA = "upstate.terrain-report-receiving/v1"


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def selection(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    payload = path.read_bytes()
    authored = json.loads(payload)
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": len(payload),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
            "selection": reports.normalize(authored)}


def _snapshot(workspace, response_id):
    response = responses.inspect(workspace, response_id)
    require(response.get("state") == "complete", "Open the completed original terrain response.")
    case_id = response["selection"]["case_id"]
    case = terrain.inspect(workspace, case_id, verify=True)
    require(case.get("state") == "complete", "Retain the original completed terrain case.")
    run_ids = [response["selection"]["baseline_run_id"],
               *[row["run_id"] for row in response["selection"]["alternatives"]]]
    require(len(run_ids) == len(set(run_ids)), "The original terrain response repeats a native run.")
    run_records = []
    for run_id in run_ids:
        run = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
        require(run["id"] == run_id and run["state"] == "complete",
                "Retain every completed original terrain run.")
        run_records.append(describe_file(workspace.root,
                           workspace.root / "runs" / run_id / "run.json"))
    bindings = []
    for row in workspace._list("terrain-conditioning-bindings"):
        if row.get("case_id") == case_id:
            bindings.append({"id": row["id"], "record": workspace._get(
                "terrain-conditioning-bindings", row["id"])})
    return {"project_id": workspace.project["id"], "case": case, "response": response,
            "run_ids": run_ids, "run_records": run_records,
            "bindings": sorted(bindings, key=lambda row: row["id"])}


def _verify_inputs(workspace, snapshot):
    require(workspace.project["id"] == snapshot["project_id"],
            "The Terrain chapter belongs to another original project.")
    require(terrain.inspect(workspace, snapshot["case"]["id"], verify=True) == snapshot["case"],
            "The original terrain case changed.")
    require(responses.inspect(workspace, snapshot["response"]["id"]) == snapshot["response"],
            "The completed original terrain response changed.")
    for member in snapshot["run_records"]:
        verify_file(workspace.root, member)
    for row in snapshot["bindings"]:
        require(workspace._get("terrain-conditioning-bindings", row["id"]) == row["record"],
                "The original terrain native binding changed.")


def prepare(workspace, output, requested, read, action, download):
    """Use the original receiver's queue, checkpoint and download ownership."""
    path = output / "terrain-inputs.json"
    if path.exists():
        inputs = read_json(path)
        require(inputs.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"]
                and inputs.get("response", {}).get("id") == requested["selection"]["response_id"],
                "Resume the original terrain response and project.")
        _verify_inputs(workspace, inputs)
    else:
        inputs = _snapshot(workspace, requested["selection"]["response_id"])
        atomic_json(path, inputs, immutable=True)
    preview_path = output / "terrain-source-preview.json"
    if preview_path.exists():
        preview = read_json(preview_path)
    else:
        preview = read("POST", "/api/terrain-conditioning/report-source-preview",
                       {"selection": requested["selection"]})
        atomic_json(preview_path, preview, immutable=True)
    require(preview.get("selection") == requested["selection"]
            and preview.get("binding", {}).get("project_id") == inputs["project_id"]
            and preview["binding"].get("case_id") == inputs["case"]["id"]
            and preview["binding"].get("response_id") == inputs["response"]["id"],
            "The source preview changed the original Terrain choices.")
    task = action("terrain_source", "terrain.conditioning.report-source.prepare",
                  {"selection": requested["selection"], "expected_id": preview["id"]})
    source = reports.inspect(workspace, preview["id"])
    require(task["result"] == source and source["state"] == "complete"
            and source["binding"] == preview["binding"],
            "The original source task changed its retained scientific identity.")
    _verify_inputs(workspace, inputs)
    detail = read("GET", "/api/terrain-conditioning",
                  {"action": "report-source", "id": source["id"]})
    tickets = detail.get("_downloads", [])
    require(len(tickets) == len(source["files"]), "Retain every original Terrain source attachment.")
    copies = []
    prefix = PurePosixPath(source["directory"])
    for member, ticket in zip(source["files"], tickets):
        relative = PurePosixPath(member["path"]).relative_to(prefix)
        require(relative.parts and ".." not in relative.parts
                and all(ticket.get(name) == member[name] for name in ("bytes", "sha256")),
                "A Terrain source ticket differs from its original file.")
        destination = output / "terrain-source" / Path(*relative.parts)
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        copied = download(ticket, destination.relative_to(output).as_posix())
        copies.append({"original": member, "path": str(copied),
                       "bytes": member["bytes"], "sha256": member["sha256"]})
    result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
              "request": requested, "inputs": inputs, "preview": preview,
              "report_source": source, "source": source["source"], "downloads": copies,
              "task_id": task["id"]}
    retained = output / "terrain-source-receiving.json"
    if retained.exists():
        require(read_json(retained) == result, "Resume the exact original Terrain source receiving chapter.")
    else:
        atomic_json(retained, result, immutable=True)
    return result


def verify(workspace, chapter, nodes=None):
    require(chapter.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "Open the original Terrain receiving chapter.")
    _verify_inputs(workspace, chapter["inputs"])
    actual = reports.inspect(workspace, chapter["report_source"]["id"])
    require(actual == chapter["report_source"],
            "Cold receiving changed the original Terrain scientific report source.")
    required = {("terrain-conditioning-cases", chapter["inputs"]["case"]["id"]),
                ("terrain-conditioning-responses", chapter["inputs"]["response"]["id"]),
                ("terrain-conditioning-report-sources", actual["id"])}
    required.update(("terrain-conditioning-bindings", row["id"])
                    for row in chapter["inputs"]["bindings"])
    required.update(("runs", run_id) for run_id in chapter["inputs"]["run_ids"])
    if nodes is not None:
        retained = {(row["kind"], row["id"]) for row in nodes}
        require(required <= retained,
                "The selected scientific Study omitted original editable Terrain or native run records.")
    return {"project_id": workspace.project["id"], "workspace": str(workspace.root),
            "case_id": chapter["inputs"]["case"]["id"],
            "response_id": chapter["inputs"]["response"]["id"],
            "report_source_id": actual["id"], "source": actual["source"],
            "native_run_ids": chapter["inputs"]["run_ids"],
            "verified_records": [{"kind": kind, "id": key} for kind, key in sorted(required)]}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Operate saved scientific reports, downloads and independent Workspace receiving.

This command uses the application's original registered source import, report,
backup and restore queues. Continue a retained operation with --resume.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import signal
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import zipfile

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(APP), str(APP / "operator")]
from model.common import atomic_json, digest, held, read_json, verify_file
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import scientific_report_editions


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def identity(path):
    checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
        for part in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            size += len(part)
            checksum.update(part)
    return {"bytes": size, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}


def archive_upload(operator, archive):
    """Reopen an exact retained upload through the original checked lookup."""
    archive = Path(archive)
    expected = {"filename": archive.name, "mime_type": "application/zip", **identity(archive)}
    upload_id = digest({"sha256": expected["sha256"], "filename": expected["filename"],
                        "media_type": expected["mime_type"]})
    metadata = operator.root / "uploads" / (upload_id + ".json")
    # Only absence of the metadata itself permits another streamed upload.
    # lstat sees a dangling metadata link as present; lookup/access/identity
    # failures must propagate instead of creating a replacement object.
    try:
        metadata.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        with archive.open("rb") as stream:
            record = operator.receive_upload(stream, expected["bytes"],
                                             expected["filename"], expected["mime_type"])
        mode = "streamed"
    else:
        record = operator.upload(upload_id)
        mode = "retained"
    require(isinstance(record, dict) and record.get("id") == upload_id
            and all(record.get(field) == value for field, value in expected.items()),
            "The original archive upload returned a different identity: " + archive.name)
    return record, {"mode": mode, "id": upload_id, **expected}


def load_operator():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "upstate_scientific_report_operator", APP / "operator/server.py")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument("--manifest", action="append", type=Path,
                        help="Original typed-report manifest; repeat in reading order.")
    source.add_argument("--selection", type=Path,
                        help="JSON with ordered sources, optional title and contact.")
    source.add_argument("--terrain-selection", type=Path,
                        help="Original Terrain response/title/reason JSON; prepares its report source without rerunning models.")
    source.add_argument("--course", type=Path,
                        help="Continue an explicit ordered manifest of original report operations.")
    parser.add_argument("--title")
    parser.add_argument("--contact-json", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--create-workspace", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--selected-study", action="store_true",
                        help="Also export and receive this report with its original editable study history.")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=1800)
    parser.add_argument("--upload-limit-gib", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--browser-node", type=Path,
                        help="Run the adjacent real browser continuation with this Node interpreter.")
    parser.add_argument("--video", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-preparation", type=Path,
                        help="Open the completed original assessment preparation in the same browser course.")
    parser.add_argument("--_native-worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not args.assessment_preparation or (args.browser_node and not args.course),
            "The assessment chapter joins one original report browser continuation with --browser-node.")
    require(not args._native_worker or not args.course,
            "The native worker continues one original report operation.")
    if args.course:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            "upstate_scientific_report_course", Path(__file__).with_name("receive_course.py"))
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module.run(args, receive, APP, identity)
    return receive(args)


# Native libraries and executor threads cannot be stopped by Future.cancel().
# Keep the existing original operation in one owned process so its deadline also
# bounds shutdown, without changing the shared operator's normal drain behavior.
WORKER_STOP_GRACE = 5.0


def _worker_command(args):
    command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--_native-worker",
               "--workspace", str(args.workspace.resolve()),
               "--output", str(args.output.resolve()),
               "--timeout", str(args.timeout),
               "--upload-limit-gib", str(args.upload_limit_gib)]
    if getattr(args, "terrain_selection", None):
        command += ["--terrain-selection", str(args.terrain_selection.resolve())]
    elif args.selection:
        command += ["--selection", str(args.selection.resolve())]
    else:
        for manifest in args.manifest or []:
            command += ["--manifest", str(manifest.resolve())]
    for name, option in (("title", "--title"), ("contact_json", "--contact-json"),
                         ("browser_node", "--browser-node"),
                         ("assessment_preparation", "--assessment-preparation")):
        value = getattr(args, name, None)
        if value is not None:
            command.append(option + "=" + str(value.resolve() if isinstance(value, Path) else value))
    for name, option in (("create_workspace", "--create-workspace"),
                         ("resume", "--resume"), ("selected_study", "--selected-study"),
                         ("video", "--video")):
        if getattr(args, name, False):
            command.append(option)
    return command


def _worker_progress(path, process_id):
    try:
        value = read_json(path)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("process_id") == process_id else None


def _stop_worker(process):
    """Stop only this receiver's process/session, including its own descendants."""
    def signal_worker(force):
        try:
            if os.name == "posix":
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL if force else signal.SIGTERM)
            elif force:
                process.kill()
            else:
                process.terminate()
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
    signal_worker(False)
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=WORKER_STOP_GRACE)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        signal_worker(True)
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=WORKER_STOP_GRACE)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            raise RuntimeError("The owned report process did not stop: " + str(process.pid)) from error
    # A native child may outlive the worker or ignore SIGTERM. Its process group
    # was created exclusively for this operation; finish stopping that group.
    if os.name == "posix":
        signal_worker(True)


def _record_worker_interruption(output, process_id, message):
    # The child has exited and released its original operation lock. Do not
    # overwrite a successor that another caller has already resumed.
    if not output.is_dir():
        return
    try:
        with held(output / ".scientific-report-receiving.lock", blocking=False):
            path = output / "receiving-progress.json"
            progress = _worker_progress(path, process_id)
            if progress is None:
                return
            if progress.get("phase") == "failed":
                return  # Preserve the child's exact native exception.
            previous = progress.get("phase")
            progress.update(phase="interrupted", interrupted_phase=previous,
                            error={"type": "TimeoutError", "message": message})
            atomic_json(path, progress)
    except BlockingIOError:
        return


def supervised_receive(args):
    """Run the same retained native receiver with a bounded per-phase lifetime."""
    process = None
    previous_termination = None
    def terminated(number, frame):
        raise SystemExit(128 + number)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    path = output / "receiving-progress.json"
    phase, began, failed_since = None, time.monotonic(), None
    failure = None
    try:
        if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
            previous_termination = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, terminated)
        process = subprocess.Popen(_worker_command(args), start_new_session=os.name == "posix")
        began = time.monotonic()
        while process.poll() is None:
            current = _worker_progress(path, process.pid)
            now = time.monotonic()
            current_phase = ((current.get("phase"), current.get("task_id"))
                             if current is not None else None)
            if current_phase is not None and current_phase != phase:
                phase, began = current_phase, now
            if current is not None and current.get("phase") == "failed":
                if failed_since is None:
                    failed_since, failure = now, current.get("error")
                if now - failed_since >= WORKER_STOP_GRACE:
                    _stop_worker(process)
                    raise RuntimeError("The original report failed and its owned native shutdown "
                                       "did not finish: " + json.dumps(failure, allow_nan=False))
            elif now - began >= args.timeout:
                # Recheck the phase at the deadline before stopping a worker that
                # may just have completed the operation and advanced its receipt.
                latest = _worker_progress(path, process.pid)
                latest_phase = ((latest.get("phase"), latest.get("task_id"))
                                if latest is not None else None)
                if latest_phase != current_phase:
                    continue
                message = ("Resume the original retained report after its " +
                           (str(phase[0]) if phase else "startup") + " phase exceeded " +
                           str(args.timeout) + " seconds; owned process " + str(process.pid))
                _stop_worker(process)
                _record_worker_interruption(output, process.pid, message)
                raise TimeoutError(message)
            time.sleep(0.1)
        return process.returncode
    except BaseException:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            _stop_worker(process)
        raise
    finally:
        if previous_termination is not None:
            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous_termination)


def receive(args):
    """Continue one original operation, including its retained output/task IDs."""
    require(args.timeout > 0 and 1 <= args.upload_limit_gib <= 64,
            "Use positive task time and upload capacity from 1 to 64 GiB.")
    workspace, out = args.workspace.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    require(not out.is_relative_to(workspace) and not workspace.is_relative_to(out)
            and not out.is_relative_to(APP) and not APP.is_relative_to(out),
            "Keep the original application, Workspace and receiving output in separate trees.")
    if not getattr(args, "_native_worker", False):
        return supervised_receive(args)
    if out.exists():
        require(args.resume and out.is_dir(), "Use --resume for the retained receiving output.")
    else:
        require(not args.resume, "The retained output is absent; start this receiving operation first.")
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
    with held(out / ".scientific-report-receiving.lock", blocking=False):
        return operate(args, workspace, out)


def operate(args, workspace, out):
    original = Workspace(workspace, create=args.create_workspace,
                         title="Upper Savannah observed science")
    manifests = [path.resolve(strict=True) for path in (args.manifest or [])]
    supplied = read_json(args.selection.resolve(strict=True)) if args.selection else {}
    require(isinstance(supplied, dict) and set(supplied) <= {"sources", "title", "contact"},
            "Selection JSON accepts the original ordered sources, title and contact.")
    require(not args.selection or isinstance(supplied.get("sources"), list) and supplied["sources"],
            "Provide a nonempty ordered source selection.")
    contact = read_json(args.contact_json.resolve(strict=True)) if args.contact_json else supplied.get("contact")
    title = args.title if args.title is not None else supplied.get("title")
    if title is not None:
        require(isinstance(title, str) and bool(title.strip()), "Enter a nonempty report title.")
    terrain_request = None
    if getattr(args, "terrain_selection", None):
        from source_tools import terrain_report_receiving
        require(args.selected_study, "The Terrain chapter retains its original editable selected Study; include --selected-study.")
        terrain_request = terrain_report_receiving.selection(args.terrain_selection)
    requested = {
        "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-selection/v1",
        "project_id": original.project["id"], "workspace": str(workspace),
        "manifests": [{"path": str(path), **identity(path)} for path in manifests],
        "sources": supplied.get("sources"), "title": title, "contact": contact,
        "selected_study": args.selected_study,
    }
    if terrain_request is not None:
        requested["terrain"] = terrain_request
    request_path = out / "receiving-selection.json"
    if request_path.exists():
        require(read_json(request_path) == requested,
                "Resume with the original sources, order, title, contact and Workspace.")
    else:
        require(not any(path.name != ".scientific-report-receiving.lock" for path in out.iterdir()),
                "The retained output lacks its original source selection.")
        atomic_json(request_path, requested, immutable=True)
    operation = digest(requested)
    progress_path = out / "receiving-progress.json"
    progress = read_json(progress_path) if progress_path.exists() else {
        "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-progress/v1",
        "operation_id": operation, "tasks": {}}
    require(progress.get("operation_id") == operation, "Reopen the matching receiving checkpoint.")

    def checkpoint(phase, **values):
        progress.update(phase=phase, **values)
        atomic_json(progress_path, progress)
        print(json.dumps({"phase": phase, **values}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)

    module = load_operator()
    operator = module.Operator(workspace, out / "operator-state", create=False,
                               source_manifests=manifests,
                               upload_limit=args.upload_limit_gib * 1024**3)
    key = operator.primary
    tasks = {}

    def receive_archive(phase, archive):
        checkpoint(phase + "_upload", archive=str(archive), upload_state="checking")
        record, receipt = archive_upload(operator, archive)
        progress.setdefault("uploads", {})[phase] = receipt
        checkpoint(phase + "_upload", archive=str(archive),
                   upload_state="verified", uploads=progress["uploads"])
        return record

    def read(method, path, payload=None, owner=None):
        return operator.extensions.read(method, path, owner or key, payload or {})

    def action(phase, name, payload):
        queued = operator.submit(key, name, payload, "report_receive_" + operation[:24] + "_" + phase)
        progress["tasks"][phase] = {"id": queued["id"], "action": name}
        checkpoint(phase, task_id=queued["id"])
        if args.resume and queued["state"] in {"failed", "interrupted", "cancelled"}:
            operator.resume(queued["id"])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + args.timeout
        while True:
            task = operator.task_view(queued["id"])
            if task["state"] == "complete":
                tasks[phase] = task
                return task
            if task["state"] in {"failed", "interrupted", "cancelled"}:
                raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(task.get("error") or task, allow_nan=False))
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("Resume the original retained report task " + task["id"])
            time.sleep(0.2)

    def download(ticket, name):
        destination = out / name
        expected = {field: ticket[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
        if destination.exists():
            require(identity(destination) == expected, "Retained download differs: " + name)
            return destination
        stream, record = operator.open_download(ticket["id"])
        temporary = destination.with_name("." + destination.name + ".receiving")
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        try:
            require({field: record[field] for field in expected} == expected,
                    "The original file ticket changed: " + name)
            checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            with temporary.open("xb") as target:
                for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    target.write(part)
                    count += len(part)
                    checksum.update(part)
                target.flush()
                os.fsync(target.fileno())
            require({"bytes": count, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()} == expected,
                    "The original download changed during transfer: " + name)
            os.link(temporary, destination)
        finally:
            stream.close()
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return destination

    try:
        checkpoint("opening", application=str(APP), workspace_key=key, process_id=os.getpid())
        routes = [
            ("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-catalog"),
            ("POST", "/api/source-reports/scientific-preview"),
            ("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition"),
        ]
        if args.selected_study:
            routes.append(("POST", "/api/study-transfer/preview"))
        require(all(operator.extensions.has_route(*route) for route in routes),
                "Install the complete saved scientific report family before receiving.")
        terrain_chapter = None
        if terrain_request is not None:
            require(operator.extensions.has_route("POST", "/api/terrain-conditioning/report-source-preview")
                    and operator.extensions.has_route("GET", "/api/terrain-conditioning"),
                    "Install the original Terrain scientific-source family.")
            terrain_chapter = terrain_report_receiving.prepare(
                original, out, terrain_request, read, action, download)
        choices = [terrain_chapter["source"]] if terrain_chapter else supplied.get("sources") or []
        if terrain_chapter and title is None:
            title = terrain_request["selection"]["title"]
        if manifests:
            choices = []
            registered = {row["path"]: row for row in operator.registered.values()}
            for index, path in enumerate(manifests):
                preview = operator.preview_source({"registered_id": registered[str(path)]["id"]})
                imported = action("source_%03d" % (index + 1), "source.import",
                                  {"preview_id": preview["id"]})["result"]
                matches = [entry for entry in imported["entries"]
                           if (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("report_schema") == "upstate.observed-report/v1"]
                require(len(matches) == 1, "Choose one typed report in manifest " + str(path))
                choices.append({"source_collection_id": imported["id"], "source_id": matches[0]["id"]})
        payload = {"sources": choices}
        if title is not None:
            payload["title"] = title
        if contact is not None:
            payload["contact"] = contact
        saved_preview = out / "report-preview.json"
        if saved_preview.exists():
            preview = read_json(saved_preview)
        else:
            preview = read("POST", "/api/source-reports/scientific-preview", payload)
            atomic_json(saved_preview, preview, immutable=True)
        require(preview.get("schema") == "upstate.observed-report-preview/v1"
                and preview.get("workspace_key") == key
                and preview.get("workspace") == str(workspace)
                and preview.get("id") == digest(preview.get("render_identity"))
                and preview.get("operation_id") == "observed-report-" + preview["id"][:20]
                and all(preview.get(name) == preview["render_identity"].get(name)
                        for name in ("title", "selection", "binding", "workspace"))
                and [{name: row[name] for name in ("source_collection_id", "source_id")}
                     for row in preview.get("sources", [])] == choices,
                "The retained preview changed the original scientific report selection.")
        scientific_report_editions.validate_request(original, payload, preview["render_identity"])
        # Submit the exact retained payload. A completed original task reopens
        # directly; a task interrupted after native rendering reconciles that
        # completed edition through the maintained render action.
        rendered = action("render", "source-reports.render", {**payload, "preview_id": preview["id"]})
        edition_id = rendered["result"]["scientific_report_edition_id"]
        require(edition_id == preview["id"], "Rendering changed the prepared scientific identity.")
        before = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id})
        edition = before["edition"]
        require(edition["render_identity"] == preview["render_identity"],
                "The saved report changed the prepared selection.")
        replay = operator.submit(key, "source-reports.render", {**payload, "preview_id": preview["id"]},
                                 "report_receive_" + operation[:24] + "_render")
        require(replay["id"] == rendered["id"] and replay["state"] == "complete",
                "The completed report did not reopen the original queued operation.")
        copied = {}
        for ticket in before["_downloads"]:
            if ticket["label"] in {"report_pdf", "report_html", "report_markdown", "report_data"}:
                path = download(ticket, ticket["filename"])
                copied[ticket["label"]] = {"path": str(path), **identity(path)}
        require({"report_pdf", "report_html", "report_markdown", "report_data"} <= copied.keys(),
                "The original report omitted a complete PDF, HTML, Markdown or data export.")
        zipped = action("report_zip", "source-reports.export", {"id": edition_id})
        complete = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id})
        report_archive = download(complete["archive"], "scientific-report.zip")
        files = {row["path"]: row for row in complete["files"]}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(report_archive) as archive:
            require(set(archive.namelist()) == set(files) and len(archive.namelist()) == len(files),
                    "The report ZIP changed the original complete file set.")
            for name, expected in files.items():
                checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                with archive.open(name) as stream:
                    for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                        count += len(part)
                        checksum.update(part)
                require(count == expected["bytes"] and checksum.hexdigest() == expected["sha256"],
                        "The report ZIP changed original member " + name)
        backup = action("backup", "workspace.backup", {"include_intermediates": True})
        tickets = backup.get("_downloads") or []
        require(len(tickets) == 1, "The original Workspace backup must expose its complete archive.")
        archive_path = download(tickets[0], "scientific-report-workspace.zip")
        upload = receive_archive("workspace", archive_path)
        restored_task = action("restore", "workspace.restore", {"upload_id": upload["id"]})
        restored_key = restored_task["result"]["workspace_key"]
        restored = operator.ws(restored_key)
        require(restored.project == original.project, "Receiving changed the original project identity.")
        after = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id}, restored_key)
        require(after["edition"] == edition, "Reopening changed the original saved report edition.")
        require(after["edition"]["render_identity"]["workspace"] == str(workspace),
                "Receiving rewrote the original authoring Workspace in the scientific identity.")
        catalog = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-catalog", owner=restored_key)
        require(any(row["id"] == edition_id for row in catalog["editions"]),
                "The received Sources desk cannot reopen its retained edition.")
        for descriptor in edition["files"].values():
            verify_file(restored.root / "scientific-report-editions" / edition_id, descriptor)
        restored_roles = {ticket["label"]: ticket for ticket in after["_downloads"]}
        for role, expected in copied.items():
            require(all(restored_roles[role][field] == expected[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")),
                    "The receiving file ticket changed " + role)
        terrain_restored = None
        if terrain_chapter:
            terrain_restored = terrain_report_receiving.verify(restored, terrain_chapter)
        selected_receiving = None
        if args.selected_study:
            selection = {"title": edition["title"] + " — editable scientific study",
                         "roots": [{"kind": "scientific-report-editions", "id": edition_id}],
                         "include_related_results": True}
            selection_path = out / "selected-report-selection.json"
            if selection_path.exists():
                retained = read_json(selection_path)
                require({name: value for name, value in retained.items() if name != "preview_token"} == selection,
                        "Resume the original selected report transfer.")
                selection = retained
            else:
                selected_preview = read("POST", "/api/study-transfer/preview", {"selection": selection})
                require(any(row["kind"] == "scientific-report-editions" and row["id"] == edition_id
                            for row in selected_preview["nodes"]),
                        "The selected study preview omitted the original report edition.")
                selection["preview_token"] = selected_preview["preview_token"]
                atomic_json(selection_path, selection, immutable=True)
            exported = action("selected_export", "study.export", selection)
            retained = exported["result"]["study"]["identity"]
            require(any(row["id"] == edition_id and row["source_choices"] == choices
                        for row in retained.get("scientific_report_editions", [])),
                    "The selected study archive omitted the ordered original report.")
            selected_tickets = exported.get("_downloads") or []
            require(len(selected_tickets) == 1, "The selected study needs its original complete archive.")
            selected_archive = download(selected_tickets[0], "selected-scientific-report-study.zip")
            selected_upload = receive_archive("selected_study", selected_archive)
            selected_task = action("selected_restore", "workspace.restore", {"upload_id": selected_upload["id"]})
            selected_key = selected_task["result"]["workspace_key"]
            selected_workspace = operator.ws(selected_key)
            require(selected_workspace.project == original.project,
                    "Selected report receiving changed its original project identity.")
            selected_detail = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition",
                                   {"id": edition_id}, selected_key)
            require(selected_detail["edition"] == edition,
                    "Selected study receiving changed the original scientific edition.")
            selected_receiving = {
                "study_id": exported["result"]["id"], "workspace_key": selected_key,
                "workspace": str(selected_workspace.root), "edition_id": edition_id,
                "archive": {"path": str(selected_archive), **identity(selected_archive)},
                "original_nodes": retained["nodes"],
                "scientific_report_editions": retained["scientific_report_editions"],
            }
        if terrain_chapter:
            require(selected_receiving is not None, "Retain the Terrain selected Study receiving result.")
            terrain_selected = terrain_report_receiving.verify(
                selected_workspace, terrain_chapter, selected_receiving["original_nodes"])
        outcome = {
            "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-workflow/v1",
            "state": "complete", "operation_id": operation, "project_id": original.project["id"],
            "edition_id": edition_id, "title": edition["title"], "sources": choices,
            "render_identity": edition["render_identity"], "edition": edition,
            "original_workspace": str(workspace), "original_workspace_key": key,
            "restored_workspace": str(restored.root), "restored_workspace_key": restored_key,
            "operator_state": str(out / "operator-state"), "application": str(APP),
            "selected_study_receiving": selected_receiving,
            "report_files": copied, "report_archive": {"path": str(report_archive), **identity(report_archive)},
            "workspace_archive": {"path": str(archive_path), **identity(archive_path)},
            "uploads": progress.get("uploads", {}),
            "tasks": {phase: {"id": task["id"], "action": task["action"], "state": task["state"]}
                      for phase, task in tasks.items()},
            "browser_handoff": {"view": "sources", "workspace_key": restored_key,
                                "edition_id": edition_id, "sources": choices},
        }
        if terrain_chapter:
            outcome["terrain"] = {**terrain_chapter, "full_received": terrain_restored,
                                  "selected_received": terrain_selected}
        atomic_json(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json", outcome)
        checkpoint("closing", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
                   edition_id=edition_id, restored_workspace_key=restored_key)
    except BaseException as error:
        checkpoint("failed", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
        raise
    finally:
        operator.close()
    if args.browser_node:
        checkpoint("browser", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"))
        try:
            browser(args, module, workspace, out)
        except BaseException as error:
            checkpoint("failed", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
            raise
    checkpoint("complete", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
               edition_id=edition_id, restored_workspace_key=restored_key)
    return 0


def browser(args, module, workspace, out):
    server, receipt = module.start_server(workspace, state_directory=out / "operator-state",
                                          upload_limit=args.upload_limit_gib * 1024**3)
    serving = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    private_url = out / ".operator-url"
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(private_url, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as target:
            target.write(receipt["operator_url"] + "\n")
        serving.start()
        command = [str(args.browser_node.resolve(strict=True)),
                   str(Path(__file__).with_name("receive_browser.mjs")),
                   "--url-file", str(private_url),
                   "--receiving-receipt", str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
                   "--output", str(out / "browser")]
        if getattr(args, "assessment_preparation", None):
            command += ["--assessment-preparation", str(args.assessment_preparation.resolve(strict=True))]
        if args.video:
            command.append("--video")
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=args.timeout)
    finally:
        if serving.is_alive():
            server.shutdown()
            serving.join()
        server.server_close()
        server.operator.close()
        private_url.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def records(document, label):
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise ValueError(label + ": expected a source packet object")
    files = document.get("files")
    if isinstance(files, list):
        result = files
    elif isinstance(files, dict):
        metadata = document.get("file_metadata", {})
        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
            raise ValueError(label + ": malformed file_metadata")
        result = []
        for name, item in files.items():
            if isinstance(item, str):
                meta = metadata.get(name, {})
                if not isinstance(meta, dict):
                    raise ValueError(label + ": malformed metadata for " + name)
                result.append(dict(meta, path=name, content=item))
            elif isinstance(item, dict):
                if "path" in item and item["path"] != name:
                    raise ValueError(label + ": conflicting path for " + name)
                result.append(dict(item, path=name))
            else:
                raise ValueError(label + ": malformed file record")
    else:
        raise ValueError(label + ": missing files")
    if not result:
        raise ValueError(label + ": empty source packet")
    return result



def transport_document(text):
    # Canvas may insert NBSP indentation. Preserve quoted source strings here;
    # repair any affected source body only under its declared hash below.
    normalized, quoted, escaped = [], False, False
    for char in text:
        if quoted:
            normalized.append(char)
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif char == '"':
                quoted = False
        else:
            normalized.append(" " if char == "\u00a0" else char)
            if char == '"':
                quoted = True
    return json.loads("".join(normalized))

    final, allowed, origins = {}, {}, {}
    for path in paths:
        packet_path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
        document = transport_document(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        seen = set()
        for item in records(document, str(packet_path)):
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                raise ValueError(str(packet_path) + ": malformed file record")
            name = checked_name(item.get("path"))
            if name in seen:
                raise ValueError(str(packet_path) + ": duplicate file " + name)
            seen.add(name)
            expected = checked_hash(item.get("sha256"), name)
            size = item.get("bytes")
            if type(size) is not int or size < 0:
                raise ValueError(name + ": expected an exact nonnegative byte length")
            if "content_base64" in item:
                if "content" in item or not isinstance(item["content_base64"], str):
                    raise ValueError(name + ": select one full source encoding")
                data = base64.b64decode(item["content_base64"], validate=True)
                content = data.decode("utf-8")
            else:
                content = item.get("content")
                if not isinstance(content, str):
                    raise ValueError(name + ": full UTF-8 content is required")
                data = content.encode("utf-8")
                if len(data) != size or sha(data) != expected:
                    candidate = content.replace("\u00a0", " ").encode("utf-8")
                    if len(candidate) == size and sha(candidate) == expected:
                        data, content = candidate, candidate.decode("utf-8")
            if len(data) != size or sha(data) != expected:
                raise ValueError(name + ": incoming byte length or SHA-256 differs")
            if name.endswith(".py"):
                ast.parse(content, filename=name)
            elif name.endswith(".json"):
                json.loads(content)
            previous = allowed.setdefault(name, set())
            if name in final:
                previous.add(sha(final[name]))
            for key in PREIMAGE_KEYS:
                value = item.get(key)
                if value is not None:
                    values = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
                    if not values:
                        raise ValueError(name + " " + key + ": expected at least one preimage SHA-256")
                    for expected_before in values:
                        previous.add(checked_hash(expected_before, name + " " + key))
            final[name], origins[name] = data, str(packet_path)
    return final, allowed, origins


def target_path(application, name):
    # Reject symlink components, including links that currently point inside
    # the application: an authored source leaf must have one stable location.
    current = application
    for component in PurePosixPath(name).parts:
        current = current / component
        if current.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Preserve and reconcile source symlink: " + name)
    if current.exists() and not current.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Expected regular source file: " + name)
    return current


def read_existing(application, name):
    path = target_path(application, name)
    return path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None


def assembled_data(application, pending, name):
    if name in pending:
        return pending[name]
    data = read_existing(application, name)
    if data is None:
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete application/component first; missing " + name)
    return data

def prepare_legacy_retirement(application, pending):
    old = read_existing(application, LEGACY)
    backup = read_existing(application, RETIRED)
    if old is not None and (len(old), sha(old)) not in LEGACY_PREDECESSORS:
        raise ValueError("Preserve and compose the newer legacy decision registration: " + LEGACY)
    if backup is not None and (len(backup), sha(backup)) not in LEGACY_PREDECESSORS:
        raise ValueError("Preserve the existing decision-registration retirement record: " + RETIRED)
    if old is not None and backup is not None and old != backup:
        raise ValueError("Preserve both distinct original decision registrations before retirement")
    descriptor = json.loads(assembled_data(application, pending, "operator/extensions/robust-workbench.json"))
    ours = set(descriptor.get("backend", {}).get("actions", []))
    directory = target_path(application, "operator/extensions/robust-workbench.json").parent
    for path in sorted(directory.glob("*.json")):
        relative = path.relative_to(application).as_posix()
        if relative in (LEGACY, "operator/extensions/robust-workbench.json"):
            continue
        content = read_existing(application, relative)
        registration = json.loads(content)
        shared = ours & set(registration.get("backend", {}).get("actions", []))
        if shared:
            raise ValueError("Compose the existing action owner before installation: " +
                             relative + " (" + ", ".join(sorted(shared)) + ")")
    return old, backup


def run(application, packet_paths, *, dry_run=False):
    application = Path(application).resolve(strict=True)
    if not application.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("Application must be a directory")
    pending, allowed, origins = read_layers(packet_paths)
    lock_root = application / ".locks"
    if lock_root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Preserve and reconcile the application's .locks symlink")
    lock_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    lock_path = lock_root / "extension-install.lock"
    if lock_path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Preserve and reconcile the extension installer lock symlink")
    with lock_path.open("a+") as lock:
        # Share the original extension installer's lock; do not create a
        # competing independent lock for modifications to the same application.
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        originals, modes, conflicts = {}, {}, []
        for name, data in pending.items():
            path = target_path(application, name)
            before = path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None
            originals[name] = before
            modes[name] = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) if before is not None else 0o644
            if before is not None and before != data and sha(before) not in allowed[name]:
                conflicts.append({"path": name, "actual_sha256": sha(before),
                                  "incoming_sha256": sha(data),
                                  "allowed_preimages": sorted(allowed[name])})
        if conflicts:
            raise ValueError("Newer or unrecognized authored files preserved; compose these exact sources first:\n" +
                             json.dumps(conflicts, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        verify_composition(application, pending)
        legacy, retired = prepare_legacy_retirement(application, pending)
        # Publish the new registration only after its provider and assets exist.
        changed = sorted((name for name in pending if originals[name] != pending[name]),
                         key=lambda name: (name == "operator/extensions/robust-workbench.json", name))
        receipt = {
            "schema": "upstate.robust-workbench-install/v1",
            "application": str(application), "dry_run": dry_run,
            "changed": changed,
            "retired_registration": {"path": LEGACY, "retained_as": RETIRED,
                                     "sha256": sha(legacy)} if legacy is not None else None,
            "files": [{"path": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha(data),
                       "previous_sha256": sha(originals[name]) if originals[name] is not None else None,
                       "packet": origins[name]} for name, data in sorted(pending.items())],
        }
        if dry_run or (not changed and legacy is None):
            return receipt
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".robust-install-", dir=application) as temporary:
            staging = Path(temporary)
            for name in changed:
                staged = staging / name
                staged.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with staged.open("wb") as stream:
                    stream.write(pending[name])
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                staged.chmod(modes[name])
            # Reconcile all inputs once more before the first replacement.
            for name in pending:
                if read_existing(application, name) != originals[name]:
                    raise RuntimeError("Concurrent authored change preserved at " + name)
            if (read_existing(application, LEGACY) != legacy or
                    read_existing(application, RETIRED) != retired):
                raise RuntimeError("Concurrent legacy registration changes preserved")
            if legacy is not None:
                # The known old descriptor owns the same twelve actions. Retain
                # its exact bytes outside *.json so the registry has one owner.
                os.replace(target_path(application, LEGACY), target_path(application, RETIRED))
            for name in changed:
                target = target_path(application, name)
                if read_existing(application, name) != originals[name]:
                    raise RuntimeError("Concurrent authored change preserved at " + name +
                                       "; compose current source and rerun the same packets")
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                os.replace(staging / name, target)
        # An interrupted install is restartable because incoming-identical
        # files are accepted and all remaining replacements retain preimages.
        for name, data in pending.items():
            if read_existing(application, name) != data:
                raise RuntimeError("Installed source changed during readback: " + name)
        return receipt


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--application", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--packet", action="append", required=True,
                        help="Decoded source JSON packet; repeat in explicit layer order")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(run(args.application, args.packet, dry_run=args.dry_run),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Disk-backed native mosaics and restartable 30 m terrain preparation.

Original tiles are mosaicked in their shared native lattice before a single
horizontal reprojection. No depression filling, hydrologic conditioning, vertical
datum transformation, invented elevations or polygon-edge zero fill is applied.
"""

def validate_grid(value: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from pyproj import CRS
    from affine import Affine
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise TerrainError("Select the original 30 m grid definition")
    crs = CRS.from_user_input(value["crs"])
    transform = list(value["transform"])
    width, height = value["width"], value["height"]
    if (len(transform) != 6 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in transform)
            or isinstance(width, bool) or isinstance(height, bool)
            or int(width) != width or int(height) != height or width <= 0 or height <= 0):
        raise TerrainError("Invalid finite terrain grid dimensions or transform")
    if (not crs.is_projected or len(crs.axis_info) < 2
            or any(abs(float(axis.unit_conversion_factor)-1) > 1e-12 for axis in crs.axis_info[:2])):
        raise TerrainError("The target terrain grid must be projected in metres")
    a, b, c, d, e, f = map(float, transform)
    if b != 0 or d != 0 or abs(a-30) > 1e-9 or abs(e+30) > 1e-9:
        raise TerrainError("The model terrain grid must use unrotated, square, exact 30 m cells")
    from rasterio.transform import array_bounds
    transform = Affine(30, 0, c, 0, -30, f)
    checked = {"crs": crs.to_wkt(), "crs_name": crs.to_string(),
            "transform": list(transform)[:6], "width": int(width), "height": int(height),
            "resolution_m": 30.0, "pixel_area_ha": 0.09,
            "bounds": list(array_bounds(int(height), int(width), transform))}
    # Retain the original grid writer's explicit publisher-rounding provenance.
    from copy import deepcopy
    for key in ("reference_alignment", "reference_normalization"):
        if key in value:
            checked[key] = deepcopy(value[key])
    return checked


def reference_grid(path: Path | str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Use the existing scientific grid writer for a complete reference raster.

    Original Annual NLCD coefficients can differ from nominal 30 metres by a
    few floating-point units. Use the SAME normalization/tolerance as native
    Workspace.prepare_grid, retain its complete provenance and preserve the
    reference's number of cells rather than expanding a rounding-only edge.
    """
    import rasterio
    from shapely.geometry import box
    from model.rasters import grid_definition
    with rasterio.open(path) as source:
        width, height = source.width, source.height
        transform = source.transform
        domain = box(transform.c, transform.f-height*30.0,
                     transform.c+width*30.0, transform.f)
    grid = grid_definition(path, domain, resolution=30.0)
    if grid["width"] != width or grid["height"] != height:
        raise TerrainError("Original reference cell counts changed during nominal-grid receiving")
    return validate_grid(grid)


def read_geometry(path: Path | str, target_crs, *, layer=None, where=None):
    """Read all selected original polygons, without simplification or silent repair."""
    import fiona
    from pyproj import CRS, Transformer
    from shapely.geometry import shape, mapping
    from shapely.ops import transform, unary_union
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    with path.open("rb") as original:
        compressed = original.read(2) == b"\x1f\x8b"
    native_path = "/vsigzip/"+path.as_posix() if compressed else str(path)
    parameters = {}
    fiona_root = Path(fiona.__file__).parent
    for key, folder in (("GDAL_DATA", "gdal_data"), ("PROJ_DATA", "proj_data"), ("PROJ_LIB", "proj_data")):
        if (fiona_root / folder).is_dir():
            parameters[key] = str(fiona_root / folder)
    geometries = []
    with fiona.Env(**parameters), fiona.open(native_path, layer=layer) as source:
        origin = CRS.from_user_input(source.crs_wkt or source.crs)
        transformer = Transformer.from_crs(origin, target_crs, always_xy=True)
        for feature in source:
            if where and any(str(feature["properties"].get(key)) != str(value) for key, value in where.items()):
                continue
            if feature["geometry"] is None:
                raise TerrainError("Selected model-domain feature has no geometry")
            polygon = shape(feature["geometry"])
            if polygon.geom_type not in ("Polygon", "MultiPolygon") or polygon.is_empty or not polygon.is_valid:
                raise TerrainError("Selected model-domain geometry is not a valid original polygon")
            projected = transform(transformer.transform, polygon)
            if projected.is_empty or not projected.is_valid or not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in projected.bounds):
                raise TerrainError("Model-domain transformation produced invalid coordinates")
            geometries.append(projected)
    if not geometries:
        raise TerrainError("The model-domain selection contains no polygons")
    combined = unary_union(geometries)
    if not combined.is_valid:
        raise TerrainError("The original selected-domain union is invalid")
    return combined, {"features": len(geometries), "original_crs": origin.to_wkt(),
                      "target_crs": CRS.from_user_input(target_crs).to_wkt(),
                      "area_ha": float(combined.area/10000), "geometry": mapping(combined)}


def plan(root: Path | str, grid: dict[str, Any], *, source_ids: list[str] | None = None,
         title: str = "Upper Savannah retained terrain", domain_path: Path | str | None = None,
         domain_layer: str | None = None, domain_where: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
         reference_path: Path | str | None = None, source_reference: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
         resampling: str = "bilinear", chunk_size: int = 1024) -> dict[str, Any]:
