        return []
    blocks.insert(0, "Open this report inside the extracted delivery folder to follow the retained "
                     "map and working-material links. Preserve the folder structure when sharing it. "
                     "The scientific workspace archive contains the original inputs and native model outputs.")
    return [("Working materials and source reports", blocks)]


def _relative_link(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise ValueError("Report links require an original relative file path")
    normalized = value.replace("\\", "/")
    path = Path(normalized)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or ":" in normalized or normalized.startswith("//"):
        raise ValueError("Report links must remain within the delivered package")
    return normalized


def _figure(block, root=None):
    """Bind a readable figure to its retained SVG and original numeric specification."""
    relative = _relative_link(block.get("path"))
    if Path(relative).suffix.lower() != ".svg":
        raise ValueError("Scientific figures require their retained original SVG")
    for name in ("alt", "caption"):
        if not isinstance(block.get(name), str) or not block[name].strip():
            raise ValueError("Scientific figures require nonempty " + name)
    if not isinstance(block.get("spec"), dict):
        raise ValueError("Scientific figures require the original numeric specification")
    size, sha = block.get("bytes"), block.get("sha256")
    if (not isinstance(size, int) or isinstance(size, bool) or size <= 0
            or not isinstance(sha, str) or len(sha) != 64
            or any(value not in "0123456789abcdef" for value in sha)):
        raise ValueError("Scientific figures require the retained SVG length and SHA256")
    if root is not None:
        directory = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
        source = (directory / relative).resolve(strict=True)
        if not source.is_relative_to(directory):
            raise ValueError("Scientific figure is outside the original delivery")
        actual = describe_file(directory, source)
        if actual["bytes"] != size or actual["sha256"] != sha:
            raise ValueError("Scientific figure differs from its retained original SVG")
    return {**block, "path": relative}


def report_pdf(path, title, sections, *, contact, source_records,
               footer="Scientific report · original model and source editions"):
    """Render the original report content with repeating, page-aware data tables."""
    from reportlab.lib import colors
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
    from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
    from reportlab.lib.units import inch
    from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Table, TableStyle, KeepTogether
    from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    styles["BodyText"].fontName = "Helvetica"
    styles["BodyText"].fontSize = 9
    styles["BodyText"].leading = 13
    styles["Heading2"].keepWithNext = True
    styles["Heading3"].keepWithNext = True
    caption_style = ParagraphStyle("ScientificTableCaption", parent=styles["BodyText"],
                                   keepWithNext=True,
                                   spaceAfter=styles["BodyText"].spaceAfter + .05 * inch)
    cell_style = ParagraphStyle("ScientificTable", parent=styles["BodyText"],
                                fontSize=8, leading=10, splitLongWords=1)
    story = [Paragraph(escape(str(title)), styles["Title"]), Spacer(1, .15 * inch)]

    def paragraph(value, style=None):
        value = _cell(value)
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            href = escape(value["href"], {'"': """})
            body = '<link href="' + href + '">' + escape(value["label"]).replace("\n", "<br/>") + "</link>"
        else:
            body = escape(value).replace("\n", "<br/>")
        return Paragraph(body, style or styles["BodyText"])

    def source_links(block):
        """Shorten only path-derived labels; preserve explicit source titles."""
        targets = [_relative_link(item["path"]) for item in block["items"]]
        titles = [str(item["title"]) for item in block["items"]]
        path_titles = [
            title == target or ("/" in title and target.endswith("/" + title))
            for title, target in zip(titles, targets)
        ]
        for index, (title, target) in enumerate(zip(titles, targets)):
            label = title
            if path_titles[index]:
                parts = target.split("/")
                for count in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
                    candidate = "/".join(parts[-count:])
                    conflict = any(
                        other_target != target
                        and ((path_titles[other] and
                              "/".join(targets[other].split("/")[-count:]) == candidate)
                             or (not path_titles[other] and titles[other] == candidate))
                        for other, other_target in enumerate(targets) if other != index
                    )
                    if not conflict:
                        label = candidate
                        break
            yield target, label

    def append(block, section_heading=None):
        if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
            from .scientific_figures import panel_drawings
            figure = _figure(block, Path(path).parent)
            heading = [paragraph(section_heading, styles["Heading2"])] if section_heading else []
            if figure.get("title"):
                heading.append(paragraph(figure["title"], styles["Heading3"]))
            drawings = list(panel_drawings(figure["spec"], 7.1 * inch))
            if not drawings:
                raise ValueError("Scientific figure contains no native report panels")
            # A title travels with its first plotted panel, not an empty page edge.
            if len(drawings) > 1:
                story.append(KeepTogether(heading + [drawings[0]]))
                story.append(Spacer(1, .08 * inch))
                for drawing in drawings[1:-1]:
                    story.extend([drawing, Spacer(1, .08 * inch)])
                heading = []
            story.append(KeepTogether(heading + [
                drawings[-1], Spacer(1, .05 * inch), paragraph(figure["caption"]),
            ]))
        elif isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "links":
            for relative, label in source_links(block):
                story.append(Paragraph('<link href="' + html_escape(relative, quote=True) + '">' +
                    escape(label) + "</link>", styles["BodyText"]))
                story.append(Spacer(1, .05 * inch))
        elif isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "table":
            if block.get("caption"):
                # Keep the caption with the table; a separate Spacer breaks
                # the heading/caption keepWithNext chain at a page boundary.
                story.append(paragraph(block["caption"], caption_style))
            from .scientific_tables import pdf_table_flowables
            story.extend(pdf_table_flowables(
                block, width=7.1 * inch, paragraph=paragraph, cell_style=cell_style,
            ))
        else:
            story.append(paragraph(block))
        story.append(Spacer(1, .08 * inch))

    for heading, blocks in sections:
        # The section heading and first figure are a single page-aware unit.
        # Explicit grouping avoids a nested KeepTogether leaving the outer title.
        if blocks and isinstance(blocks[0], dict) and blocks[0].get("kind") == "figure":
            append(blocks[0], section_heading=heading)
            remaining = blocks[1:]
        else:
            story.append(paragraph(heading, styles["Heading2"]))
            remaining = blocks
        for block in remaining:
            append(block)
    story.append(paragraph("Source editions", styles["Heading2"]))
    append(_source_block(source_records))
    prepared = " · ".join(str(contact[key]).strip() for key in ("name", "organization", "email") if contact.get(key))
    if prepared:
        story.append(paragraph("Prepared by " + prepared))

    def page_number(canvas, document):
        canvas.saveState()
        canvas.setFont("Helvetica", 7)
        canvas.drawString(.7 * inch, .42 * inch, str(footer))
        canvas.drawRightString(7.8 * inch, .42 * inch, str(document.page))
        canvas.restoreState()

    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    SimpleDocTemplate(str(path), pagesize=letter, rightMargin=.7 * inch, leftMargin=.7 * inch,
                      topMargin=.65 * inch, bottomMargin=.65 * inch,
                      title=str(title), author=str(contact.get("organization", ""))).build(
                          story, onFirstPage=page_number, onLaterPages=page_number)


def _figure_image(block, root):
    """Encode the exact verified source bytes for self-contained HTML viewing."""
    figure = _figure(block)
    directory = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    source = (directory / figure["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if not source.is_relative_to(directory):
        raise ValueError("Scientific figure is outside the original delivery")
    payload = source.read_bytes()
    if len(payload) != figure["bytes"] or sha256(payload).hexdigest() != figure["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Scientific figure differs from its retained original SVG")
    return "data:image/svg+xml;base64," + base64.b64encode(payload).decode("ascii")


def _html_block(block, *, figure_images=None):
    def cell(value):
        value = _cell(value)
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return '<a href="' + html_escape(value["href"], quote=True) + '">' + html_escape(value["label"]).replace("\n", "<br>") + "</a>"
        escaped = html_escape(value).replace("\n", "<br>")
        import re
        if re.fullmatch(r"[+−-]?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+−-]?[0-9]+)?%?", value.strip()):
            return '<span class="scientific-number">' + escaped + '</span>'
        return escaped
    if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
        figure = _figure(block)
        title = ("<strong>" + cell(figure["title"]) + "</strong> "
                 if figure.get("title") else "")
        return ('<figure class="scientific-figure"><img src="' +
                html_escape(figure_images[figure["path"]] if figure_images is not None
                            else figure["path"], quote=True) + '" alt="' +
                html_escape(figure["alt"], quote=True) + '"><figcaption>' +
                title + cell(figure["caption"]) + "</figcaption></figure>")
    if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "links":
        return "<ul>" + "".join(
            '<li><a href="' + html_escape(_relative_link(item["path"]), quote=True) + '">' +
            cell(item["title"]) + "</a></li>" for item in block["items"]) + "</ul>"
    if not isinstance(block, dict) or block.get("kind") != "table":
        return "<p>" + cell(block) + "</p>"
    caption = "<caption>" + cell(block["caption"]) + "</caption>" if block.get("caption") else ""
    head = "".join("<th scope=\"col\">" + cell(value) + "</th>" for value in block["columns"])
    rows = "".join("<tr>" + "".join("<td>" + cell(value) + "</td>" for value in row)
                   + "</tr>" for row in block["rows"])
    label = str(block.get("caption") or ("Data table: " + ", ".join(str(value) for value in block["columns"])))
    hint = ('<p class="table-scroll-hint">Scroll horizontally to read every column. '
            'Keyboard users can focus the table region and use the arrow keys.</p>'
            if len(block["columns"]) > 3 else "")
    return (hint + '<div class="table-wrap" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="' +
            html_escape(label, quote=True) + '"><table>' + caption +
            "<thead><tr>" + head + "</tr></thead><tbody>" + rows + "</tbody></table></div>")


def _markdown_cell(value):
    def plain(text):
        return (str(text).replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("|", "\\|")
                .replace("[", "\\[").replace("]", "\\]")
                .replace("*", "\\*").replace("_", "\\_")
                .replace("`", "\\`").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
                .replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "<br>"))
    value = _cell(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        href = value["href"].replace("<", "%3C").replace(">", "%3E").replace(" ", "%20").replace("|", "%7C")
        return "[" + plain(value["label"]) + "](<" + href + ">)"
    return plain(value)


def _markdown_report(title, sections, prepared):
    lines = ["# " + _markdown_cell(title), ""]
    for heading, blocks in sections:
        lines.extend(["## " + _markdown_cell(heading), ""])
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
                figure = _figure(block)
                # Reuse the maintained link/cell escaping for original captions and paths.
                lines.extend(["!" + _markdown_cell(link(figure["alt"], figure["path"])), ""])
                if figure.get("title"):
                    lines.extend([_markdown_cell(figure["title"]), ""])
                lines.extend([_markdown_cell(figure["caption"]), ""])
            elif isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "table":
                if block.get("caption"):
                    lines.extend([_markdown_cell(block["caption"]), ""])
                lines.append("| " + " | ".join(_markdown_cell(v) for v in block["columns"]) + " |")
                lines.append("| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in block["columns"]) + " |")
                lines.extend("| " + " | ".join(_markdown_cell(v) for v in row) + " |" for row in block["rows"])
                lines.append("")
            elif isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "links":
                for item in block["items"]:
                    lines.append("- " + _markdown_cell(link(item["title"], _relative_link(item["path"]))))
                lines.append("")
            else:
                lines.extend([_markdown_cell(block), ""])
    lines.extend([_markdown_cell(prepared), ""])
    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_companions(directory, title, sections, *, contact, source_records, binding,
                     subtitle="Scientific model results, scenario changes and retained source editions.",
                     footer="Original scientific study, source editions and model selections retained with this report."):
    """Retain offline HTML and complete structured report blocks in the delivery."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    all_sections = list(sections) + [("Source editions", [_source_block(source_records)])]
    figure_images = {}
    for _, blocks in all_sections:
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
                figure = _figure(block)
                figure_images[figure["path"]] = _figure_image(figure, directory)
    headings = "".join("<li><a href=\"#section-" + str(index) + "\">" + html_escape(str(heading))
                       + "</a></li>" for index, (heading, _) in enumerate(all_sections))
    content = "".join("<section id=\"section-" + str(index) + "\"><h2>"
                      + html_escape(str(heading)) + "</h2>"
                      + "".join(_html_block(block, figure_images=figure_images)
                                for block in blocks) + "</section>"
                      for index, (heading, blocks) in enumerate(all_sections))
    supplied_contact = " · ".join(str(contact[key]).strip() for key in ("name", "organization", "email") if contact.get(key))
    prepared = ("Prepared by " + supplied_contact if supplied_contact
                else str(footer))
    body = (
        "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\">"
        "<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\">"
        "<title>" + html_escape(str(title)) + "</title><style>"
        "*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#fff;color:#171717;font:15px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif}"
        "main{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:32px;background:#fff;color:#171717}h1{font-size:30px;line-height:1.2}"
        "h2{font-size:21px;border-bottom:1px solid #777;padding-bottom:8px;margin-top:32px}"
        "a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;overflow-wrap:anywhere}li{overflow-wrap:anywhere}nav{border:1px solid #aaa;padding:12px 20px}"
        "nav ol{columns:2;margin:8px 0;padding-left:20px}section{scroll-margin-top:20px}"
        "p{max-width:95ch;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;margin:16px 0;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}"
        ".table-wrap:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #333;outline-offset:3px}.table-scroll-hint{display:none}"
        "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}th,td{text-align:left;vertical-align:top;"
        "padding:8px;min-width:8rem;background:#fff;color:#171717;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;overflow-wrap:normal;word-break:normal}.scientific-number{white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}th{background:#eee;color:#171717;border-bottom:1px solid #444}"
        "caption{text-align:left;margin-bottom:8px}.scientific-figure{margin:20px 0}"
        ".scientific-figure img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}"
        ".scientific-figure figcaption{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;max-width:95ch}"
        "footer{border-top:1px solid #777;margin-top:32px;padding-top:16px}"
        "@media(max-width:620px){main{padding:16px}nav ol{columns:1}h1{font-size:25px}.table-scroll-hint{display:block;font-size:13px}}"
        "@media print{main{max-width:none;padding:0}nav,.table-scroll-hint{display:none}.table-wrap{overflow:visible}th,td{min-width:0}"
        "thead{display:table-header-group}tr{break-inside:avoid}h2{break-after:avoid}body{font-size:10pt}"
        "table{font-size:8pt}a{text-decoration:none}@page{margin:16mm}}"
        "</style></head><body><main><h1>" + html_escape(str(title))
        + "</h1><p>" + html_escape(str(subtitle)) + "</p>"
        "<nav aria-label=\"Report sections\"><strong>Contents</strong><ol>" + headings + "</ol></nav>"
        + content + "<footer>" + html_escape(prepared) + "</footer></main></body></html>\n"
    )
    html_path, data_path = directory / "report.html", directory / "report-data.json"
    markdown_path = directory / "report.md"
    atomic_bytes(markdown_path, _markdown_report(title, all_sections, prepared).encode("utf-8"))
    atomic_bytes(html_path, body.encode("utf-8"))
    atomic_json(data_path, {
        "schema": REPORT_VERSION, "title": title, "binding": binding,
        "sections": [{"heading": heading, "blocks": blocks} for heading, blocks in sections],
        "source_records": source_records, "contact": contact,
        "presentation": {"subtitle": str(subtitle), "footer": prepared},
        "display_precision": "Six significant digits; complete original numeric data remains in the working project",
    })
    # Every editable companion consumes the exact original structured document.
    # Its source edition, displayed values and figures remain the same selection.
    from .scientific_report_odt import write_odt
    from .scientific_report_workbook import write_workbook
    report_data_bytes = data_path.read_bytes()
    return {"report_html": describe_file(directory, html_path),
            "report_markdown": describe_file(directory, markdown_path),
            "report_data": describe_file(directory, data_path),
            "report_odt": write_odt(directory, report_data_bytes),

"""Read immutable saved scientific report editions inside their Workspace.

The native report desk and customer-review preparation share this one retained
edition contract. Original output files, ordered source binding and rendering
identity are verified together before another workflow consumes the report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import zipfile

from .common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, held, identifier, read_json, relative_file, verify_file
from . import observed_context

KIND = "scientific-report-editions"
SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-edition/v1"


def directory(workspace, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve()
    selected = root / KIND / key
    if selected.resolve().is_relative_to(root) is False:
        raise ValueError("Keep the saved report inside its original Workspace")
    return selected


def record(workspace, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    selected = directory(workspace, key)
    value = read_json(selected / "edition.json")
    if (value.get("schema") != SCHEMA or value.get("id") != key
            or value.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or digest(value.get("render_identity")) != key):
        raise ValueError("The saved report edition identity changed")
    return value, selected


def inspect(workspace, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    value, selected = record(workspace, key)
    result = read_json(selected / "operation.json")
    identity = value["render_identity"]
    if (result.get("state") != "complete"
            or result.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + key[:20]
            or any(result.get(name) != item for name, item in identity.items())
            or result.get("files") != value.get("files")
            or read_json(selected / "selection.json") != identity):
        raise ValueError("The completed report differs from its saved selection")
    if observed_context.bind(workspace, identity["selection"]) != identity["binding"]:
        raise ValueError("The saved report's original scientific source edition changed")
    for item in result["files"].values():
        verify_file(selected, item)
    if value.get("capture_origin") is not None:
        from .scientific_report_capture import verify_origin
        verify_origin(workspace, value, selected)
    return value, selected, result


def files(value, selected):
    selected = Path(selected)
    members = dict(value["files"])
    for role, name in (("operation", "operation.json"), ("edition", "edition.json")):
        if role in members:
            raise ValueError("Original report output uses a reserved saved-edition role")
        members[role] = describe_file(selected, selected / name)
    return members


class PreviewChanged(ValueError):
    """The selected native source edition differs from its reviewed preview."""


def preview(workspace, payload):
    """Prepare the same ordered-source preview used by the SourceReports queue."""
    from . import observed_report_render as renderer
    result = renderer.prepare(workspace, payload.get("sources"), title=payload.get("title"),
                              contact=payload.get("contact"))
    key = digest(result["render_identity"])
    return {**result, "id": key, "existing": (directory(workspace, key) / "edition.json").is_file()}



def validate_request(workspace, payload, identity):
    """Match an original report request without binding it to today's renderer."""
    supplied = payload.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(supplied, list) or not supplied:
        raise ValueError("Choose one or more retained scientific report sources")
    choices = observed_context.source_choices({"observed_context_sources": supplied})
    if choices != observed_context.source_choices(identity["selection"]):
        raise PreviewChanged("The retained report belongs to another ordered source selection.")
    titles = []
    for choice in choices:
        _, entry = workspace.source_file(choice["source_collection_id"], choice["source_id"])
        titles.append(entry["title"])
    title = payload.get("title")
    if title is not None and (not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip()):
        raise ValueError("Enter a nonempty report title")
    resolved = title.strip() if title is not None else (
        titles[0] if len(titles) == 1 else "Observed science: " + "; ".join(titles))
    contact = payload.get("contact")
    if contact is None:
        contact = {}
    if (not isinstance(contact, dict)
            or any(not isinstance(contact.get(name, ""), str)
                   for name in ("name", "organization", "email"))):
        raise ValueError("Report contact details must be text")
    if identity.get("title") != resolved or identity.get("contact") != contact:
        raise PreviewChanged("The retained report belongs to another title or contact.")
    if observed_context.bind(workspace, identity["selection"]) != identity.get("binding"):
        raise PreviewChanged("The retained report's original scientific source edition changed.")
    return choices


def _save_edition(workspace, identity, result):
    """Publish the edition from the original completed native operation."""
    key = digest(identity)
    selected = directory(workspace, key)
    value = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
             "title": identity["title"], "render_identity": identity,
             **{name: result[name] for name in (
                 "state", "operation_id", "source_count", "section_count",
                 "figure_count", "sources", "files")}}
    if (selected / "edition.json").is_file():
        previous = read_json(selected / "edition.json")
        if previous.get("capture_origin") is not None:
            original = dict(previous)
            original.pop("capture_origin")
            if original != value:
                raise ValueError("The completed report differs from its adopted original edition.")
            value = previous
    atomic_json(selected / "edition.json", value, immutable=True)
    inspect(workspace, key)
    return {"scientific_report_edition_id": key, "title": value["title"],
            "state": "complete", "source_count": value["source_count"],
            "operation_id": value["operation_id"]}


def render_prepared(workspace, prepared):
    """Complete a retained original preview through the existing native renderer.

    An original preview can retain its source-host path after Workspace transfer.
    Its project belongs to the caller's retained operation; source bindings and
    installed rendering bodies are checked by the same original rendering engine.
    """
    from . import observed_report_render as renderer
    identity = prepared["render_identity"]
    key = digest(identity)
    if (prepared.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report-preview/v1"
            or prepared.get("id") != key
            or prepared.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + key[:20]
            or any(prepared.get(name) != identity.get(name)
                   for name in ("title", "selection", "binding", "workspace"))):
        raise ValueError("Use the retained original scientific report preview")
    choices = observed_context.source_choices(identity["selection"])
    if (prepared.get("source_count") != len(choices)
            or [{"source_collection_id": row["source_collection_id"], "source_id": row["source_id"]}
                for row in prepared.get("sources", [])] != choices):
        raise ValueError("The original report preview changed its ordered source selection")
    selected = directory(workspace, key)
    # The original renderer owns report locking, native file reuse, original
    # source retention, figure drawing and its installed-code identity checks.
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"):
        result = renderer.render(workspace, prepared, selected)
        return _save_edition(workspace, identity, result)


def render(workspace, payload):
    """Reopen completed original output, or render the explicitly reviewed preview."""
    key = payload.get("preview_id")
    if key is not None:
        selected = directory(workspace, key)
        # Rendering publishes operation.json before edition.json and the queue's
        # completion record. Reconcile that exact completed effect first, even
        # when installed formatting source has advanced since this request.
        if (selected / "operation.json").is_file():
            with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"):
                identity = read_json(selected / "selection.json")
                result = read_json(selected / "operation.json")
                if (identity.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report-native/v1"
                        or digest(identity) != key
                        or result.get("state") != "complete"
                        or result.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + key[:20]
                        or any(result.get(name) != value for name, value in identity.items())):
                    raise ValueError("The retained completed report differs from its original preview")
                choices = validate_request(workspace, payload, identity)
                if (result.get("source_count") != len(choices)
                        or [{"source_collection_id": row["source_collection_id"],
                             "source_id": row["source_id"]} for row in result.get("sources", [])]
                        != choices):
                    raise ValueError("The completed report changed its ordered original sources")
                for item in result["files"].values():
                    verify_file(selected, item)
                return _save_edition(workspace, identity, result)
    prepared = preview(workspace, payload)
    if payload.get("preview_id") != prepared["id"]:
        raise PreviewChanged("Preview this exact ordered study selection before preparing its report.")
    return render_prepared(workspace, prepared)


def export(workspace, key):
    """Retain the complete original report ZIP for native and web consumers."""
    record, directory, _ = inspect(workspace, identifier(key))
    destination = directory / "report-files.zip"
    receipt = directory / "report-files.json"
    report_files = files(record, directory)
    members = {item["path"]: item for item in report_files.values()}
    identity = {name: {field: item[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
                for name, item in sorted(members.items())}
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"), held(directory / ".export.lock"):
        if receipt.exists():
            prior = read_json(receipt)
            if prior.get("members") != identity:
                raise ValueError("The saved report archive belongs to another edition")
            verify_file(directory, prior["file"])
        else:
            fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".report-files-", suffix=".zip", dir=directory)
            os.close(fd)
            temporary = Path(temporary_name)
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
                                     allowZip64=True) as archive:
                    for name, item in sorted(members.items()):
                        path = relative_file(directory, name)
                        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                        info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                        info.external_attr = 0o100600 << 16
                        info.file_size = item["bytes"]
                        count, checksum = 0, hashlib.sha256()
                        with path.open("rb") as source, archive.open(
                                info, "w", force_zip64=item["bytes"] >= zipfile.ZIP64_LIMIT) as target:
                            while chunk := source.read(1024 * 1024):
                                count += len(chunk)
                                checksum.update(chunk)
                                target.write(chunk)
                        if count != item["bytes"] or checksum.hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
                            raise ValueError("A saved scientific report file changed: " + name)
                os.replace(temporary, destination)
                atomic_json(receipt, {"members": identity,
                                     "file": describe_file(directory, destination)}, immutable=True)
            finally:
                temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
