"""Present an exact saved scientific report and retain its complete offline edition."""
from __future__ import annotations
import copy
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import zipfile
from .common import (atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, held,
                     identifier, read_json, relative_file, verify_file)
from . import client_briefing

SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-briefing-report/v1"
RECORD = "upstate.scientific-briefing-edition/v1"
EDITION = "2026-10-13-ordered-scientific-briefing-1"
KIND = "scientific-report-briefings"
FILES = {"model": "scientific-briefing-model.json",
         "html": "scientific-briefing.html", "index": "scientific-briefing-index.json"}


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                      separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def _sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def _directory(workspace, kind, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    root = workspace.root.resolve()
    directory = root / kind / key
    if directory.is_symlink() or not directory.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Keep the saved briefing in its original Workspace")
    return directory


def original(workspace, edition_id):
    """Open the original saved report through its existing edition contract."""
    from . import observed_context
    directory = _directory(workspace, "scientific-report-editions", edition_id)
    record = read_json(directory / "edition.json")
    identity = record.get("render_identity")
    if (record.get("schema") != "upstate.scientific-report-edition/v1"
            or record.get("id") != edition_id
            or record.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or digest(identity) != edition_id):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report identity changed")
    result = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    if (result.get("state") != "complete"
            or result.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + edition_id[:20]
            or any(result.get(name) != value for name, value in identity.items())
            or result.get("files") != record.get("files")
            or read_json(directory / "selection.json") != identity):
        raise ValueError("The completed scientific report differs from its saved selection")
    if observed_context.bind(workspace, identity["selection"]) != identity["binding"]:
        raise ValueError("The report's original scientific sources changed")
    files = dict(record["files"])
    for role, name in (("operation", "operation.json"), ("edition", "edition.json")):
        if role in files:
            raise ValueError("The original report uses a reserved edition role")
        files[role] = describe_file(directory, directory / name)
    for item in files.values():
        verify_file(directory, item)
    if "report_data" not in files or "report_html" not in files:
        raise ValueError("Prepare the complete scientific report before presenting it")
    return record, directory, files


def _sections(data):
    """Keep every original block in order and its original report anchor."""
    sections = []
    for number, source in enumerate(data["sections"]):
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(source.get("blocks"), list):
            raise ValueError("Retain the complete original scientific section blocks")
        heading = str(source["heading"])
        blocks = source["blocks"] or [""]
        for block_number, block in enumerate(blocks):
            row = {"id": "section-" + str(number) + "-block-" + str(block_number),
                   "title": heading, "original_anchor": "section-" + str(number),
                   "original_section": number, "original_block": block_number,
                   "paragraphs": [], "tables": [], "assets": [], "figures": [],
                   "core": True}
            if isinstance(block, dict):
                kind = block.get("kind")
                if kind == "table":
                    if (not isinstance(block.get("columns"), list) or not block["columns"]
                            or not isinstance(block.get("rows"), list)
                            or any(not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) != len(block["columns"])
                                   for values in block["rows"])):
                        raise ValueError("Keep every original scientific table column and row")
                    row["tables"] = [{**copy.deepcopy(block), "scientific_cells": True}]
                elif kind == "links":
                    row["assets"] = [{"path": item["path"], "title": item["title"]}
                                     for item in block["items"]]
                    if any(client_briefing._path(item["path"]) is None for item in row["assets"]):
                        raise ValueError("Scientific report assets must stay in the complete delivery")
                elif kind == "figure":
                    row["figures"] = [copy.deepcopy(block)]
                elif kind == "link":
                    row["scientific_paragraphs"] = [copy.deepcopy(block)]
                else:
                    raise ValueError("The original scientific block kind is unsupported")
            else:
                row["scientific_paragraphs"] = [copy.deepcopy(block)]
            sections.append(row)
    source_rows = []
    for item in data.get("source_records", []):
        source_rows.append([item.get("title", item.get("id", "")), item.get("id", ""),
                            item.get("source_id", ""), item.get("vintage", ""),
                            item.get("uri", ""), item.get("sha256", "")])
    sections.append({"id": "original-source-editions", "title": "Original source editions",
                     "original_anchor": "section-" + str(len(data["sections"])),
                     "paragraphs": [], "tables": [{"columns": [
                         "Source", "Role", "Retained document", "Edition", "Original reference", "SHA256"],
                         "rows": source_rows, "scientific_cells": True}],
                     "assets": [], "figures": [], "core": True})
    return sections


def _build(workspace, edition_id):
    record, directory, originals = original(workspace, edition_id)
    body = verify_file(directory, originals["report_data"]).read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(body)
    if (not isinstance(data.get("sections"), list)
            or data.get("binding", {}).get("observed_context") != record["render_identity"]["binding"]
            or data.get("binding", {}).get("selection") != record["render_identity"]["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("The saved report data differs from its original ordered source selection")
    identity = {"edition": EDITION, "source_edition_id": edition_id,
                "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "report_data": originals["report_data"],
                "renderer_sha256": _sha(Path(client_briefing.__file__).read_bytes()),
                "adapter_sha256": _sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())}
    key = digest(identity)
    source = {"edition_id": edition_id, "briefing_id": key, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
              "report_data": originals["report_data"],
              "canonical_sha256": _sha(_json(data).encode("utf-8")),
              "ordered_sources": copy.deepcopy(record["sources"])}
    report = {"schema": SCHEMA, "report_edition": EDITION, "title": record["title"],
              "report_kind_label": "Saved scientific report",
              "delivery_mode": "scientific_report", "source_report": source,
              "original_report": data, "sections": _sections(data), "maps": [],
              "source_scope": [
                  {"label": "Original studies", "value": record["source_count"]},
                  {"label": "Original report sections", "value": record["section_count"]},
                  {"label": "Original scientific figures", "value": record["figure_count"]}]}
    # Each image retains its original SVG and numeric specification. Local links
    # are resolved against the exact existing member inventory, including data.
    members = {item["path"]: item for item in originals.values()}
    for section in report["sections"]:
        for asset in section.get("assets", []):
            if asset["path"] not in members:
                raise ValueError("A scientific report asset is absent from its saved edition")
        for figure in section.get("figures", []):
            item = members.get(figure.get("path"))
            if (item is None or not str(figure["path"]).endswith(".svg")
                    or client_briefing._path(figure["path"]) is None
                    or any(item[field] != figure.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256"))
                    or not isinstance(figure.get("spec"), dict)
                    or any(not isinstance(figure.get(field), str) or not figure[field].strip()
                           for field in ("alt", "caption"))):
                raise ValueError("Keep the scientific figure with its original SVG and numeric specification")
    return key, identity, report, record, directory, originals


def report_binding(report, report_model_bytes=None):
    """Bind presentation notes to the complete original scientific report data."""
    source, data = report.get("source_report"), report.get("original_report")
    if (report.get("schema") != SCHEMA or report.get("delivery_mode") != "scientific_report"
            or not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(data, dict)
            or not isinstance(report.get("sections"), list) or report.get("maps") != []
            or source.get("canonical_sha256") != _sha(_json(data).encode("utf-8"))):
        raise ValueError("Retain the complete original scientific briefing model")
    for field in ("edition_id", "briefing_id"):
        value = source.get(field)
        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
            raise ValueError("The scientific briefing needs its exact saved edition identity")
    if report_model_bytes is None:
        body, method = _json(report).encode("utf-8"), "sha256-canonical-json-utf8"
    else:
        if (not isinstance(report_model_bytes, bytes)
                or _json(json.loads(report_model_bytes)) != _json(report)):
            raise ValueError("The original scientific briefing model bytes differ")
        body, method = report_model_bytes, "sha256-original-report-model-bytes"
    return {"schema": client_briefing.EDITION, "report_sha256": _sha(body),
            "report_digest_method": method, "report_edition": report["report_edition"],
            "report_kind": "scientific_report", "source_report": source,
            "delivery_id": source["briefing_id"], "baseline_run_id": None,
            "alternative_run_ids": [], "title": report["title"],
            "delivery_mode": "scientific_report", "grid_id": None, "profile_id": None}


def preview(workspace, edition_id):
    key, identity, report, source, directory, originals = _build(workspace, edition_id)
    slides, _ = client_briefing._slides(report)
    return {"schema": "upstate.scientific-briefing-preview/v1", "id": key,
            "source_edition_id": edition_id, "title": report["title"],
            "source_count": source["source_count"], "section_count": source["section_count"],
            "figure_count": source["figure_count"], "page_count": len(slides),
            "original_file_count": len(originals),
            "existing": (_directory(workspace, KIND, key) / "briefing.json").is_file()}


def create(workspace, edition_id, *, expected_id):
    key, identity, report, source, original_root, originals = _build(workspace, edition_id)
    if key != expected_id:
        raise ValueError("Preview the exact saved scientific report before preparing its briefing")
    directory = _directory(workspace, KIND, key)
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"), held(directory / ".briefing.lock"):
        if (directory / "briefing.json").is_file():
            saved, _ = inspect(workspace, key)
            return saved
        model_body = (_json(report) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        figure_images = {figure["path"]: "data:image/svg+xml;base64," + base64.b64encode(
            verify_file(original_root, next(item for item in originals.values()
                if item["path"] == figure["path"])).read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
            for section in report["sections"] for figure in section.get("figures", [])}
        document, index = client_briefing.render(
            report, report_href=originals["report_html"]["path"],
            model_href=FILES["model"], report_model_bytes=model_body, figure_images=figure_images)
        bodies = {"model": model_body, "html": document.encode("utf-8"),
                  "index": (_json(index) + "\n").encode("utf-8")}
        if set(FILES.values()) & {row["path"] for row in originals.values()}:
            raise ValueError("An original report uses a reserved briefing filename")
        files = {}
        for role, body in bodies.items():
            atomic_bytes(directory / FILES[role], body, immutable=True)
            files[role] = describe_file(directory, directory / FILES[role])
        saved = {"schema": RECORD, "id": key, "state": "complete",
                 "identity": identity, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
                 "source_edition_id": edition_id, "title": source["title"],
                 "source_count": source["source_count"], "section_count": source["section_count"],
                 "figure_count": source["figure_count"], "page_count": len(index["slides"]),
                 "files": files, "original_files": originals}
        atomic_json(directory / "briefing.json", saved, immutable=True)
    inspect(workspace, key)
    return saved


def inspect(workspace, key):
    directory = _directory(workspace, KIND, key)
    record = read_json(directory / "briefing.json")
    if (record.get("schema") != RECORD or record.get("id") != key
            or record.get("state") != "complete"
            or record.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or digest(record.get("identity")) != key):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific briefing identity changed")
    source, original_root, originals = original(workspace, record["source_edition_id"])
    if originals != record["original_files"]:
        raise ValueError("The briefing differs from the original saved report files")
    for item in record["files"].values():
        verify_file(directory, item)
    body = verify_file(directory, record["files"]["model"]).read_bytes()
    report = json.loads(body)
    binding = report_binding(report, body)
    original_body = verify_file(original_root, originals["report_data"]).read_bytes()
    if (report["source_report"]["edition_id"] != record["source_edition_id"]
            or report["source_report"]["briefing_id"] != key
            or report["source_report"]["report_data"] != originals["report_data"]
            or _json(json.loads(original_body)) != _json(report["original_report"])
            or read_json(directory / record["files"]["index"]["path"]).get("binding") != binding):
        raise ValueError("The briefing model and original scientific report differ")
    return record, directory


def members(workspace, key):
    record, directory = inspect(workspace, key)
    original_root = _directory(workspace, "scientific-report-editions", record["source_edition_id"])
    result = {}
    for root, files in ((original_root, record["original_files"]), (directory, record["files"])):
        for descriptor in files.values():
            name = descriptor["path"]
            if name in result and any(result[name][field] != descriptor[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")):
                raise ValueError("Original report and briefing files conflict at a retained path")
            result[name] = {**descriptor, "source": str(verify_file(root, descriptor))}
    receipt = describe_file(directory, directory / "briefing.json")
    if receipt["path"] in result:
        raise ValueError("The original report uses a reserved briefing record filename")
    result[receipt["path"]] = {**receipt, "source": str(directory / receipt["path"])}
    return record, directory, result


def export(workspace, key):
    """Stream every original report member and all briefing files into one ZIP."""
    record, directory, files = members(workspace, key)
    archive, receipt = directory / "scientific-briefing.zip", directory / "archive.json"
    inventory = {name: {field: row[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
                 for name, row in sorted(files.items())}
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"), held(directory / ".archive.lock"):
        if receipt.exists():
            saved = read_json(receipt)
            if saved.get("members") != inventory:
                raise ValueError("The briefing archive belongs to another original edition")
            verify_file(directory, saved["file"])
        else:
            fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".scientific-briefing-", suffix=".zip", dir=directory)
            os.close(fd)
            temporary = Path(temporary_name)
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, allowZip64=True) as output:
                    for name, row in sorted(files.items()):
                        path = Path(row["source"])
                        if path.is_symlink():
                            raise ValueError("Use ordinary original report files")
                        entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                        entry.compress_type, entry.external_attr = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, 0o100600 << 16
                        entry.file_size = row["bytes"]
                        count, checksum = 0, hashlib.sha256()
                        with path.open("rb") as source, output.open(
                                entry, "w", force_zip64=row["bytes"] >= zipfile.ZIP64_LIMIT) as target:
                            before = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                            for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                                count += len(chunk); checksum.update(chunk); target.write(chunk)
                            after = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                        if (count != row["bytes"] or checksum.hexdigest() != row["sha256"]
                                or any(getattr(before, field) != getattr(after, field) for field in
                                       ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns"))):
                            raise ValueError("An original report member changed: " + name)
                with temporary.open("rb") as completed:
                    os.fsync(completed.fileno())
                os.replace(temporary, archive)
                if os.name != "nt":
                    descriptor = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
                    try:
                        os.fsync(descriptor)
                    finally:
                        os.close(descriptor)
                atomic_json(receipt, {"members": inventory,
                                     "file": describe_file(directory, archive)}, immutable=True)
            finally:
                temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        saved = read_json(receipt)
    return {**record, "archive": saved["file"]}


def notes_sources(workspace, key):
    record, directory = inspect(workspace, key)
    return {"report": verify_file(directory, record["files"]["model"]),
            "index": verify_file(directory, record["files"]["index"])}

"""Prepare existing customer reviews from original saved scientific reports.

The completed HTML is a native source document; its PDF, data, figures, original
source members and edition records remain beside it. Existing review export,
responses, reconciliation and complete Workspace receiving own the review flow.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import json
import shutil

from . import reviews, scientific_report_editions
from .common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, read_json, verify_file
from .workspace import Workspace

SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-review/v1"
EDITION = "scientific-report-review-20261013-v1"
ROLE = "SCIENTIFIC_REPORT_REVIEW"


def _workspace(value):
    return value if hasattr(value, "import_sources") and hasattr(value, "root") else Workspace(value)


def _draft(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("Provide the customer review title, purpose and review questions")
    allowed = {"title", "purpose", "requirements", "notes"}
    if set(value) - allowed:
        raise ValueError("Unknown scientific report review field: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(value) - allowed)))
    draft = {
        "title": reviews._text(value.get("title"), "Review title", required=True, maximum=300),
        "purpose": reviews._text(value.get("purpose"), "Selected review purpose", required=True),
    }
    requirements = []
    for item in reviews._list(value.get("requirements", []), "requirements"):
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) - {"id", "title", "detail"}:
            raise ValueError("Each requirement needs id, title and detail")
        requirements.append({
            "id": reviews._key(item.get("id"), "Requirement ID"),
            "title": reviews._text(item.get("title"), "Requirement title", required=True, maximum=500),
            "detail": reviews._text(item.get("detail", ""), "Requirement detail"),
        })
    reviews._unique([item["id"] for item in requirements], "requirements")
    draft["requirements"] = requirements
    draft["notes"] = [reviews._text(item, "Review note")
                      for item in reviews._list(value.get("notes", []), "notes")]
    return draft


def _context(workspace, edition_id, review_selection):
    record, directory, result = scientific_report_editions.inspect(workspace, edition_id)
    members = scientific_report_editions.files(record, directory)
    primary = members.get("report_html")
    if not isinstance(primary, dict) or not str(primary.get("path", "")).endswith(".html"):
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed scientific edition with its original HTML report")
    inventory, by_path = [], {}
    for role, item in sorted(members.items()):
        path = verify_file(directory, item)
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(directory.resolve()):
            raise ValueError("Scientific report members must stay inside their original edition")
        relative = path.relative_to(directory).as_posix()
        descriptor = {"path": relative, "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
        if relative in by_path:
            if by_path[relative] != descriptor:
                raise ValueError("One scientific report member has conflicting identities")
        else:
            by_path[relative] = descriptor
            inventory.append(descriptor)
    inventory.sort(key=lambda item: item["path"])
    primary_path = primary["path"]
    if primary_path not in by_path:
        raise ValueError("The original HTML is absent from the complete report inventory")
    required = {"edition.json", "operation.json", "selection.json"}
    if not required.issubset(by_path):
        raise ValueError("The report lacks its original edition, operation or selection")
    identity = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
        "scientific_report_edition_id": record["id"], "edition_record_sha256": digest(record),
        "render_identity": deepcopy(record["render_identity"]),
        "primary_path": primary_path, "members": inventory,
    }
    draft = _draft(review_selection)
    source_key = digest(identity)
    request = {"schema": SCHEMA + "/preview", "source_identity": identity, "review_selection": draft}
    return {"record": record, "directory": directory, "members": by_path,
            "identity": identity, "source_key": source_key, "draft": draft,
            "operation_id": digest(request), "primary": primary_path}


def preview_review(workspace, edition_id, review_selection):
    """Verify a complete saved scientific edition without changing its Workspace."""
    workspace = _workspace(workspace)
    context = _context(workspace, edition_id, review_selection)
    record = context["record"]
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "state": "preview", "operation_id": context["operation_id"],
        "scientific_report_edition_id": record["id"], "title": record["title"],
        "review_selection": deepcopy(context["draft"]),
        "source_identity": deepcopy(context["identity"]),
        "original_study_count": record["source_count"],
        "section_count": record["section_count"], "figure_count": record["figure_count"],
        "sources": deepcopy(record["sources"]),
        "member_count": len(context["members"]),
        "bytes": sum(row["bytes"] for row in context["members"].values()),
        "primary_path": context["primary"],
        "members": deepcopy(context["identity"]["members"]),
    }


def _copy_original(source, target, descriptor):
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
        if (target.is_symlink() or not target.is_file()
                or target.stat().st_size != descriptor["bytes"]
                or file_digest(target) != descriptor["sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("A retained original scientific report file differs: " + descriptor["path"])
        return
    pending = target.with_name("." + target.name + ".pending")
    try:
        shutil.copyfile(source, pending)
        if pending.stat().st_size != descriptor["bytes"] or file_digest(pending) != descriptor["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The original scientific report changed while being retained")
        pending.replace(target)
    finally:
        pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _verify_source(workspace, receipt, context):
    if receipt.get("schema") != SCHEMA or receipt.get("source_identity") != context["identity"]:
        raise ValueError("The saved report review source belongs to another original edition")
    for item in receipt["files"]:
        verify_file(workspace.root, item)
    primary_path, entry = workspace.source_file(receipt["source_collection_id"], receipt["source_id"])
    if (entry.get("role") != ROLE or entry.get("metadata", {}).get("scientific_report_identity") != context["identity"]
            or entry["body"]["sha256"] != context["members"][context["primary"]]["sha256"]
            or entry["body"]["bytes"] != context["members"][context["primary"]]["bytes"]):
        raise ValueError("The imported review source differs from the original report")
    collection = workspace._get("sources", receipt["source_collection_id"])
    if digest(collection) != receipt["source_collection_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The retained scientific review source collection changed")
    if file_digest(primary_path) != entry["body"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original report HTML source changed")
    actual = {}
    for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        native_path = item.get("view_path", item["filename"])
        if native_path in actual:
            raise ValueError("The imported review source repeats an original member")
        actual[native_path] = {"bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
    # Workspace source views may remove the common report/ directory. The
    # filename-relative tree itself must remain identical for original HTML links.
    body_name = entry["body"].get("view_path", entry["body"]["filename"])
    prefix = "report/" if body_name == "report/" + context["primary"] else ""
    expected = {prefix + path: {key: row[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")}
                for path, row in context["members"].items()}
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("The imported source does not retain the complete original report tree")
    return receipt


def _source(workspace, context):
    root = workspace.root / "scientific-report-reviews" / context["source_key"] / "source"
    if root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Keep report review sources inside their original Workspace")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt_path = root / "source-receipt.json"
    with held(root / "source.lock"):
        if receipt_path.is_file():
            return _verify_source(workspace, read_json(receipt_path), context)
        for relative, descriptor in context["members"].items():
            original = verify_file(context["directory"], descriptor)
            _copy_original(original, root / "report" / relative, descriptor)
        originals = {relative: describe_file(root, root / "report" / relative)
                     for relative in context["members"]}
        primary = originals[context["primary"]]
        record = context["record"]
        source_id = "scientific-report-review-" + context["source_key"]
        entry = {
            "id": source_id, "kind": "document", "role": ROLE,
            "title": record["title"],
            "uri": "urn:upstate:scientific-report:" + workspace.project["id"] + ":" + record["id"],
            "vintage": "Saved scientific edition " + record["id"],
            "description": "Completed original scientific report with its PDF, data, figures, "
                           "source members and immutable edition records.",
            **primary,
            "companions": [row for name, row in originals.items() if name != context["primary"]],
            "metadata": {
                "report_schema": scientific_report_editions.SCHEMA,
                "scientific_report_identity": deepcopy(context["identity"]),
                "scientific_report_edition_id": record["id"],
                "ordered_observed_source_binding": deepcopy(record["render_identity"]["binding"]),
                "original_study_count": record["source_count"],
                "section_count": record["section_count"], "figure_count": record["figure_count"],
            },
        }
        manifest = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1",
                    "title": record["title"] + " — original scientific review edition",
                    "entries": [entry],
                    "notes": ["Native rendered report files are retained unchanged in one relative tree.",
                              "Original observed study ordering and source binding remain in the edition metadata."]}
        atomic_json(root / "model-sources.json", manifest, immutable=True)
        collection = workspace.import_sources(root / "model-sources.json")
        receipt = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "source_identity": context["identity"],
            "source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id,
            "source_collection_sha256": digest(collection),
            "directory": root.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix(),
            "files": [describe_file(workspace.root, root / "model-sources.json"),
                      *[describe_file(workspace.root, root / "report" / relative)
                        for relative in sorted(context["members"])]],
        }
        _verify_source(workspace, receipt, context)
        atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt, immutable=True)
        return receipt


def create_review(workspace, edition_id, review_selection, *, expected_operation_id, created_at):
    """Prepare an original review using its queue-retained creation timestamp."""
    workspace = _workspace(workspace)
    context = _context(workspace, edition_id, review_selection)
    if expected_operation_id != context["operation_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The report edition or review questions changed; preview them again")
    original_time = reviews._date(created_at, "Review creation time")
    source = _source(workspace, context)
    selection = {"schema": reviews.SELECTION_SCHEMA, **deepcopy(context["draft"]),
                 "source_collection_ids": [source["source_collection_id"]],
                 "run_ids": [], "delivery_ids": [], "spatial_export_ids": []}
    review = reviews.create_review(workspace, selection, created_at=original_time)
    reviewed = reviews.show_review(workspace, review["id"], previews=False)
    if reviewed["review"]["id"] != review["id"]:
        raise ValueError("The created customer review could not be reopened")
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "state": "complete", "operation_id": context["operation_id"],
        "scientific_report_edition_id": context["record"]["id"],
        "review_id": review["id"], "created_at": original_time,
        "title": review["title"], "purpose": review["purpose"],
        "source_collection_id": source["source_collection_id"], "source_id": source["source_id"],
        "source_identity": context["identity"], "review_selection": selection,
        "artifact_count": len(review["artifacts"]),
        "original_study_count": context["record"]["source_count"],
        "source_member_count": len(context["members"]),
        "source_directory": source["directory"],
        "source_receipt": describe_file(workspace.root, workspace.root / source["directory"] / "source-receipt.json"),
    }


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--edition-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--review-selection", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--expected-operation-id")
    parser.add_argument("--created-at")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    selection = read_json(args.review_selection)
    if args.preview:
        result = preview_review(args.workspace, args.edition_id, selection)
    else:
        if not args.expected_operation_id or not args.created_at:
            parser.error("Review creation needs the preview operation ID and original creation timestamp")
        result = create_review(args.workspace, args.edition_id, selection,
                               expected_operation_id=args.expected_operation_id, created_at=args.created_at)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Adopt completed native CLI reports into the original saved-edition lifecycle.

TokenJunkieLabs. The original renderer and archive capture remain authoritative.
Adoption retains their bytes and render identity; it never renders a new report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from .common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, held, identifier, read_json, relative_file, verify_file
from . import observed_context
from . import scientific_report_editions as editions

KIND = "observed-reports"
CAPTURE_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report-capture/v1"
ORIGIN_SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-capture-origin/v1"
PREVIEW_SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-capture-preview/v1"


def _file(root, name):
    root = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    path = relative_file(root, name)
    if (path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file()
            or path.resolve(strict=True) != root / name):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original captured report files at their ordinary retained paths.")
    return path


def _verified(root, descriptor, *, contents=True):
    if (not isinstance(descriptor, dict) or type(descriptor.get("bytes")) is not int
            or descriptor["bytes"] < 0):
        raise ValueError("The captured report needs its exact file length and SHA256.")
    identifier(descriptor.get("sha256"))
    path = _file(root, descriptor.get("path"))
    if path.stat().st_size != descriptor["bytes"]:
        raise ValueError("A retained completed report file changed length.")
    if contents:
        verify_file(root, descriptor)
    return path


def _capture_directory(workspace, capture_id):
    capture_id = identifier(capture_id)
    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve(strict=True)
    directory = root / KIND / capture_id
    if (directory.is_symlink() or not directory.is_dir()
            or directory.resolve(strict=True) != directory):
        raise ValueError("Choose an original completed report captured inside this Workspace.")
    return directory


def _validate(workspace, capture_id, capture, identity, result, operation):
    if (not isinstance(capture, dict) or capture.get("schema") != CAPTURE_SCHEMA
            or capture.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]):
        raise ValueError("The captured report belongs to another original project.")
    if (not isinstance(identity, dict)
            or identity.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report-native/v1"):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original completed report selection.")
    edition_id = digest(identity)
    if (not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("state") != "complete"
            or result.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + edition_id[:20]
            or any(result.get(name) != value for name, value in identity.items())):
        raise ValueError("The captured operation differs from its completed render identity.")
    retained_key = digest({name: value for name, value in result.items()
                           if name not in ("files", "output")})
    if capture_id != retained_key:
        raise ValueError("The completed report capture has another original identity.")
    files = result.get("files")
    if (not isinstance(files, dict) or not files or "operation" in files or "capture" in files
            or any(not isinstance(item, dict) for item in files.values())):
        raise ValueError("Keep the complete original report file roles and descriptors.")
    if (capture.get("operation_id") != result["operation_id"]
            or capture.get("selection") != identity.get("selection")
            or capture.get("report_binding") != identity.get("binding")
            or capture.get("files") != {**files, "operation": operation}):
        raise ValueError("The capture differs from its original operation, sources or files.")
    if (files.get("selection") or {}).get("path") != "selection.json":
        raise ValueError("The original report selection file is missing.")
    if any(item.get("path") in ("edition.json", ".adoption.json") for item in files.values()):
        raise ValueError("An original report file uses the saved-edition metadata path.")
    if (not isinstance(identity.get("selection"), dict)
            or not isinstance(identity["selection"].get("source_roles", {}), dict)):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original report's source selection object and role mapping.")
    choices = observed_context.source_choices(identity["selection"])
    sources = result.get("sources")
    if (not isinstance(sources, list) or any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in sources)
            or result.get("source_count") != len(choices)
            or [{"source_collection_id": row.get("source_collection_id"),
                 "source_id": row.get("source_id")} for row in sources] != choices):
        raise ValueError("The completed report changed its original source order.")
    for role in ("report_pdf", "report_html", "report_data"):
        if role not in files:
            raise ValueError("Keep the completed report's original PDF, HTML and data files.")
    return edition_id


def _load(workspace, capture_id, *, verify=True, bind=True):
    directory = _capture_directory(workspace, capture_id)
    capture_path = _file(directory, "capture.json")
    captured = describe_file(directory, capture_path)
    raw = capture_path.read_bytes()
    if len(raw) != captured["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != captured["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The report capture changed while it was read.")
    capture_text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    capture = json.loads(capture_text)
    operation = describe_file(directory, _file(directory, "operation.json"))
    result = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    identity = read_json(_file(directory, "selection.json"))
    edition_id = _validate(workspace, capture_id, capture, identity, result, operation)
    seen = {}
    for descriptor in capture["files"].values():
        name = descriptor.get("path")
        _verified(directory, descriptor, contents=verify)
        previous = seen.setdefault(name, descriptor)
        if previous != descriptor:
            raise ValueError("Captured report roles disagree about an original file.")
    if bind and observed_context.bind(workspace, identity["selection"]) != identity["binding"]:
        raise ValueError("The original captured report sources changed.")
    return {"directory": directory, "capture_id": capture_id, "capture": capture,
            "capture_text": capture_text, "capture_file": captured,
            "operation_file": operation, "result": result,
            "identity": identity, "edition_id": edition_id}


def _summary(workspace, value):
    result = value["result"]
    members = {item["path"]: item for item in value["capture"]["files"].values()}
    return {"capture_id": value["capture_id"], "edition_id": value["edition_id"],
            "capture_sha256": value["capture_file"]["sha256"],
            "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": result["title"],
            "operation_id": result["operation_id"], "source_count": result["source_count"],
            "section_count": result["section_count"], "figure_count": result["figure_count"],
            "file_count": len(members), "bytes": sum(item["bytes"] for item in members.values()),
            "state": "complete", "sources": deepcopy(result["sources"]),
            "registered": (editions.directory(workspace, value["edition_id"]) / "edition.json").is_file()}


def catalog(workspace):
    reports, issues = [], []
    for path in sorted((Path(workspace.root) / KIND).glob("*/capture.json")):
        try:
            # The catalogue checks identities and lengths. An explicit preview
            # and queued adoption verify every original report byte and source.
            reports.append(_summary(workspace, _load(
                workspace, path.parent.name, verify=False, bind=False)))
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            issues.append({"capture_id": path.parent.name, "message": str(error)})
    return {"reports": reports, "issues": issues}


def preview(workspace, capture_id):
    value = _load(workspace, identifier(capture_id))
    return {"schema": PREVIEW_SCHEMA, **_summary(workspace, value),
            "render_identity": deepcopy(value["identity"])}


def verify_origin(workspace, record, directory):
    """Verify optional adoption provenance without requiring the donor capture."""
    origin = record.get("capture_origin")
    if origin is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(origin, dict) or origin.get("schema") != ORIGIN_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("The saved report's original capture provenance changed.")
    capture_id = identifier(origin.get("capture_id"))
    captured = origin.get("capture")
    if (not isinstance(captured, dict) or not isinstance(captured.get("content"), str)
            or type(captured.get("bytes")) is not int):
        raise ValueError("Retain the complete original capture document.")
    raw = captured["content"].encode("utf-8")
    if (len(raw) != captured["bytes"]
            or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != identifier(captured.get("sha256"))):
        raise ValueError("The saved report's original capture bytes changed.")
    operation = describe_file(directory, _file(directory, "operation.json"))
    result = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    capture = json.loads(captured["content"])
    key = _validate(workspace, capture_id, capture, record["render_identity"], result, operation)
    if key != record["id"]:
        raise ValueError("The original capture belongs to another saved report edition.")


def adopt(workspace, capture_id, *, expected_capture_sha256, expected_edition_id):
    capture_id = identifier(capture_id)
    expected_capture_sha256 = identifier(expected_capture_sha256)
    expected_edition_id = identifier(expected_edition_id)
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock"):
        value = _load(workspace, capture_id)
        if (value["edition_id"] != expected_edition_id
                or value["capture_file"]["sha256"] != expected_capture_sha256):
            raise ValueError("Review this exact completed report capture again before adopting it.")
        result, identity = value["result"], value["identity"]
        target = editions.directory(workspace, expected_edition_id)
        if target.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Keep the saved edition in its original ordinary directory.")
        if target.exists():
            record, directory, original = editions.inspect(workspace, expected_edition_id)
            if (record["render_identity"] != identity or record["files"] != result["files"]
                    or original != result):
                raise ValueError("A saved edition with this render identity retains different original bytes.")
            return {"scientific_report_edition_id": expected_edition_id,
                    "capture_id": capture_id, "title": record["title"],
                    "state": "complete", "operation_id": result["operation_id"],
                    "source_count": result["source_count"], "reused": True}
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stage = target.parent / ("." + expected_edition_id + ".capture-" + expected_capture_sha256)
        if stage.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Keep the adoption stage in the original saved-edition directory.")
        stage.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        request = {"capture_id": capture_id, "capture_sha256": expected_capture_sha256,
                   "edition_id": expected_edition_id, "project_id": workspace.project["id"]}
        atomic_json(stage / ".adoption.json", request, immutable=True)
        # The same original immutable copy routine retains existing files exactly.
        from .observed_report_render import _retain_original
        for descriptor in value["capture"]["files"].values():
            source = _verified(value["directory"], descriptor)
            destination = stage / descriptor["path"]
            if destination.is_symlink() or destination.resolve() != stage.resolve() / descriptor["path"]:
                raise ValueError("Keep adopted report files inside their ordinary stage.")
            _retain_original(source, destination, descriptor)
            _verified(stage, descriptor)
        record = {"schema": editions.SCHEMA, "id": expected_edition_id,
                  "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": identity["title"],
                  "render_identity": deepcopy(identity),
                  **{name: deepcopy(result[name]) for name in (
                      "state", "operation_id", "source_count", "section_count",
                      "figure_count", "sources", "files")},
                  "capture_origin": {"schema": ORIGIN_SCHEMA, "capture_id": capture_id,
                      "capture": {"content": value["capture_text"],
                                  "bytes": value["capture_file"]["bytes"],
                                  "sha256": value["capture_file"]["sha256"]}}}
        atomic_json(stage / "edition.json", record, immutable=True)
        verify_origin(workspace, record, stage)
        declared = {item["path"] for item in value["capture"]["files"].values()}
        declared.update({"edition.json", ".adoption.json"})
        for path in stage.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("The report adoption stage contains an aliased member.")
            if path.is_file() and path.relative_to(stage).as_posix() not in declared:
                if path.name.startswith(".observed-source-"):
                    path.unlink()
                else:
                    raise ValueError("The report adoption stage contains an undeclared file.")
        (stage / ".adoption.json").unlink()
        os.rename(stage, target)
        if os.name != "nt":
            fd = os.open(target.parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
            try:
                os.fsync(fd)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
        editions.inspect(workspace, expected_edition_id)
        return {"scientific_report_edition_id": expected_edition_id,
                "capture_id": capture_id, "title": record["title"],
                "state": "complete", "operation_id": result["operation_id"],
                "source_count": result["source_count"], "reused": False}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("catalog")
    for name in ("preview", "adopt"):
        command = commands.add_parser(name)
        command.add_argument("capture_id")
        if name == "adopt":
            command.add_argument("--capture-sha256", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--edition-id", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    from .workspace import Workspace
    workspace = Workspace(Path(args.workspace).resolve())
    if args.command == "catalog":
        result = catalog(workspace)
    elif args.command == "preview":
        result = preview(workspace, args.capture_id)
    else:
        result = adopt(workspace, args.capture_id,
                       expected_capture_sha256=args.capture_sha256,
                       expected_edition_id=args.edition_id)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Scientist-authored source editions, retained only through Workspace.import_sources."""
from __future__ import annotations
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import tempfile
from .common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, read_json
from . import scientific_synthesis_catalog as references

SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-synthesis-record/v1"
DOCUMENT_SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-synthesis-document/v1"
MARKER = "upstate.scientific-synthesis-source/v1"
KINDS = ("finding", "interpretation", "limitation", "next-work")
LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024

def _text(value, label, required=False):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\0" in value or len(value) > 1000000:
        raise ValueError(label + " must be ordinary text")
    if required and not value.strip():
        raise ValueError("Enter " + label)
    return value

def _id(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,127}", value):
        raise ValueError(label + " is invalid")
    return value

def _sha(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value):
        raise ValueError(label + " is invalid")
    return value

def document(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != DOCUMENT_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Select an original scientist-authored document")
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    _id(value.get("series_id"), "Series identity")
    for name in ("title", "revision_name", "question", "scope", "change_note"):
        _text(value.get(name), name, name in ("title", "revision_name", "question"))
    author = value.get("author")
    if not isinstance(author, dict):
        raise ValueError("Retain the attributed author")
    for name in ("name", "organization", "email"):
        _text(author.get(name), "author " + name, name == "name")
    sources = value.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(sources, list) or not sources:
        raise ValueError("Select the original scientific studies")
    seen = set()
    for choice in sources:
        if not isinstance(choice, dict):
            raise ValueError("Source choice must retain its original identities")
        _sha(choice.get("source_collection_id"), "Source collection")
        _text(choice.get("source_id"), "source ID", True)
        pair = (choice["source_collection_id"], choice["source_id"])
        if pair in seen:
            raise ValueError("Select each original source once")
        seen.add(pair)
    if not isinstance(value.get("sections"), list):
        raise ValueError("Retain the authored sections")
    seen, findings = set(), 0
    for row in value["sections"]:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("Authored sections must be objects")
        _id(row.get("id"), "Section identity")
        if row["id"] in seen or row.get("kind") not in KINDS:
            raise ValueError("Retain distinct sections with an explicit kind")
        seen.add(row["id"])
        _text(row.get("heading"), "section heading", True)
        _text(row.get("text"), "section text", True)
        ids = row.get("reference_ids")
        if (not isinstance(ids, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x for x in ids)
                or len(set(ids)) != len(ids)):
            raise ValueError("Retain distinct original reference IDs")
        if row["kind"] == "finding":
            findings += 1
            if not ids:
                raise ValueError("Each finding needs an exact original source reference")
    if value.get("fork_origin") is not None:
        origin = value["fork_origin"]
        if not isinstance(origin, dict):
            raise ValueError("Retain the explicit original fork source")
        _sha(origin.get("collection_id"), "Original fork collection")
        _sha(origin.get("revision_id"), "Original fork revision")
    if not findings:
        raise ValueError("Write at least one source-linked finding")
    if len(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("An authored document supports up to 8 MiB of UTF-8 text")
    return value

def _selected_entry(collection):
    rows = [row for row in collection["entries"]
            if isinstance(row.get("metadata"), dict)
            and row["metadata"].get("scientific_synthesis_schema") == MARKER]
    if len(rows) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Choose a complete original scientist-authored source edition")
    return rows[0]

def _member(root, entry, name):
    rows = [row for row in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]
            if row.get("view_path", row["filename"]) == name]
    if len(rows) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The authored source companion is absent: " + name)
    row = rows[0]
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size != row["bytes"] or file_digest(path) != row["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The authored source companion changed: " + name)
    return path

def inspect(workspace, collection_id):
    collection = workspace.retained_item("sources", _sha(collection_id, "Authored collection"))
    entry = _selected_entry(collection)
    body, retained_entry = workspace.source_file(collection_id, entry["id"])
    root = body.parent
    record = read_json(_member(root, retained_entry, "synthesis-record.json"))
    history = read_json(_member(root, retained_entry, "synthesis-history.json"))
    current_catalog = read_json(_member(root, retained_entry, "source-catalog.json"))
    if record.get("schema") != SCHEMA or digest({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k != "revision_id"}) != record.get("revision_id"):
        raise ValueError("The authored revision identity changed")
    document(record["document"])
    marker = {"schema":MARKER,"series_id":record["document"]["series_id"],"revision":record["revision"],
              "revision_id":record["revision_id"],"operation_id":record["operation_id"],"request_sha256":record["request_sha256"]}
    if collection.get("scope", {}).get("scientific_synthesis") != marker:
        raise ValueError("The authored collection marker differs from its retained revision")
    if entry["metadata"].get("series_id") != marker["series_id"] or entry["metadata"].get("revision_id") != marker["revision_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The source entry metadata differs from its authored edition")
    if (not isinstance(history, list) or not history or history[-1] != record
            or len(history) != record["revision"]):
        raise ValueError("The full authored revision history differs")
    previous = None
    for index, item in enumerate(history, 1):
        if (item.get("schema") != SCHEMA or item.get("revision") != index
                or item.get("project_id") != record["project_id"]
                or item.get("document", {}).get("series_id") != record["document"]["series_id"]
                or item.get("previous_revision_id") != previous
                or digest({k:v for k,v in item.items() if k != "revision_id"}) != item.get("revision_id")):
            raise ValueError("The retained authored history is not one complete revision chain")
        document(item["document"])
        request = item.get("request")
        if (not isinstance(request, dict) or digest(request) != item["request_sha256"]
                or request.get("document") != item["document"]
                or request.get("operation_id") != item["operation_id"]
                or request.get("catalog_sha256") != item["catalog"].get("catalog_sha256")
                or request.get("base_collection_id") != item["previous_collection_id"]):
            raise ValueError("The complete original authored request differs")
        references.bind_references(item["catalog"], list(dict.fromkeys(key for row in item["document"]["sections"] for key in row["reference_ids"])))
        previous = item["revision_id"]
    if record["catalog"] != current_catalog:
        raise ValueError("The retained authored reference catalog differs")
    return {"collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"], "record": record,
            "history": history, "catalog": current_catalog,
            "source": {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"]},
            "foreign_project": record["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]}

def list_editions(workspace, series_id=None):
    result = []
    for collection in workspace.sources():
        scope = collection.get("scope")
        marker = scope.get("scientific_synthesis") if isinstance(scope, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(marker, dict) or marker.get("schema") != MARKER:
            continue
        if series_id is not None and marker.get("series_id") != series_id:
            continue
        _id(marker.get("series_id"), "Retained series identity")
        _id(marker.get("operation_id"), "Retained operation identity")
        _sha(marker.get("revision_id"), "Retained revision identity")
        _sha(marker.get("request_sha256"), "Retained original request identity")
        if isinstance(marker.get("revision"), bool) or not isinstance(marker.get("revision"), int) or marker["revision"] < 1:
            raise ValueError("The retained authored revision number is invalid")
        entry = _selected_entry(collection)
        result.append({**marker, "collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": entry["id"],
                       "title": entry["title"], "vintage": entry["vintage"]})
    return sorted(result, key=lambda row:(row["series_id"], row["revision"], row["collection_id"]))

def _recipe(record, archives):
    doc = record["document"]
    refs = {row["id"]: row for row in record["catalog"]["references"]}
    source_titles = {(row["source_collection_id"],row["source_id"]):row["title"] for row in record["catalog"]["sources"]}
    sections = [
        ["Scientist-authored synthesis", [
            doc["title"], "Edition: " + doc["revision_name"],
            "Prepared by " + doc["author"]["name"] + (" · " + doc["author"]["organization"] if doc["author"]["organization"] else ""),
            "Produced with the TJLabs scientific workspace. Scientific conclusions below are attributed to the named author.",
        ]],
        ["Decision question and scope", [doc["question"], doc["scope"]]],
    ]
    for row in doc["sections"]:
        blocks = [row["text"]]
        if row["reference_ids"]:
            blocks.append({"kind": "table", "columns": ["Original study", "Reference", "Location"],
                           "rows": [[source_titles[(refs[key]["source_collection_id"],refs[key]["source_id"])],
                                     refs[key]["title"], refs[key]["member_path"] + refs[key].get("pointer", "")]
                                    for key in row["reference_ids"]]})
        sections.append([{"finding":"Finding", "interpretation":"Interpretation", "limitation":"Limitation",
                          "next-work":"Next work"}[row["kind"]] + " · " + row["heading"], blocks])
    sections.append(["Authored revision history", [{"kind":"table",
        "columns":["Edition","Author","Change note","Original request"],
        "rows":[[r["document"]["revision_name"],r["document"]["author"]["name"],
                 r["document"]["change_note"],r["operation_id"]] for r in record["_history"]]}]])
    links = [{"title":"Complete editable authored revision and exact source catalog", "path":"synthesis-record.json"},
             {"title":"Full attributed revision history", "path":"synthesis-history.json"},
             {"title":"Complete original source archive identities", "path":"original-source-archives.json"}]
    links += [{"title": row["title"] + " — complete original source edition ZIP", "path":row["path"]} for row in archives]
    sections.append(["Complete original sources and editable authorship", [{"kind":"links","items":links}]])
    return {"schema":"upstate.observed-report/v1", "title":doc["title"],
            "report_context_kind":"scientist-authored-synthesis", "sections":sections,
            "figures":[], "source_links":links}

def save(workspace, payload, *, archive_source, staging_root, created_at):
    """Publish one immutable native source collection; replay precedes current-head CAS."""
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original synthesis save request")
    operation_id = _id(payload.get("operation_id"), "Original operation ID")
    doc = document(payload.get("document"))
    expected_catalog = _sha(payload.get("catalog_sha256"), "Original catalog identity")
    base_id = payload.get("base_collection_id")
    if base_id is not None:
        _sha(base_id, "Prior authored source collection")
    request_sha = digest(payload)
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock", blocking=False):
        all_rows = list_editions(workspace)
        rows = [row for row in all_rows if row["series_id"] == doc["series_id"]]
        matching = [row for row in all_rows if row["operation_id"] == operation_id]
        if matching:
            if any(row["request_sha256"] != request_sha for row in matching):
                raise ValueError("The original operation ID already names a different complete request")
            result = inspect(workspace, matching[0]["collection_id"])
            return {**result, "replayed":True}
        head_revision = max((row["revision"] for row in rows), default=0)
        heads = [row for row in rows if row["revision"] == head_revision]
        if len({row["revision_id"] for row in heads}) > 1:
            raise ValueError("This series contains different native heads; select a new explicitly attributed series")
        if heads and base_id not in {row["collection_id"] for row in heads}:
            raise ValueError("The authored series advanced. Reopen its current edition and preserve this working copy before making a revision")
        if not heads and base_id is not None:
            raise ValueError("The original prior authored edition is not registered")
        base = inspect(workspace, base_id) if base_id else None
        if base and base["foreign_project"]:
            raise ValueError("This original chapter belongs to another project. Explicitly fork a new authored series")
        if base and base["record"]["document"]["series_id"] != doc["series_id"]:
            raise ValueError("The prior edition belongs to another authored series")
        if base and not doc["change_note"].strip():
            raise ValueError("Describe this revision's change")
        origin = doc.get("fork_origin")
        if origin:
            original = inspect(workspace, origin["collection_id"])
            if original["record"]["revision_id"] != origin["revision_id"] or original["record"]["document"]["series_id"] == doc["series_id"]:
                raise ValueError("An explicit fork must retain its actual original edition and a new series identity")
        catalog = references.catalog(workspace, doc["sources"])
        if catalog["catalog_sha256"] != expected_catalog:
            raise ValueError("Original reference selection changed; reopen the complete source catalog")
        used = list(dict.fromkeys(key for row in doc["sections"] for key in row["reference_ids"]))
        references.bind_references(catalog, used)
        record = {"schema":SCHEMA, "project_id":workspace.project["id"],
                  "document":doc, "catalog":catalog, "revision":head_revision+1,
                  "previous_collection_id":base_id,
                  "previous_revision_id":base["record"]["revision_id"] if base else None,
                  "operation_id":operation_id, "request_sha256":request_sha,
                  "request":copy.deepcopy(payload), "saved_at":created_at}
        record["revision_id"] = digest(record)
        history = (base["history"] if base else []) + [record]
        collections = {}
        for edition in history:
            for choice in edition["document"]["sources"]:
                collections.setdefault(choice["source_collection_id"], choice)
        for edition in history:
            origin = edition["document"].get("fork_origin")
            if origin:
                collections.setdefault(origin["collection_id"], origin)
        stage_parent = Path(staging_root)
        stage_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="synthesis-", dir=stage_parent) as temporary:
            folder = Path(temporary)
            archives = []
            for collection_id in collections:
                result = archive_source(collection_id)
                source = Path(result["path"])
                expected = result["descriptor"]
                if source.stat().st_size != expected["bytes"] or file_digest(source) != expected["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("The original source archive changed before retention")
                relative = "original-sources/" + collection_id + ".zip"
                target = folder / relative
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(source, target)
                if file_digest(target) != expected["sha256"] or target.stat().st_size != expected["bytes"]:
                    raise ValueError("The complete original source archive changed during retention")
                archives.append({"original_collection_id":collection_id, "path":relative,
                                 "title":result["title"], **{k:expected[k] for k in ("bytes","sha256")},
                                 "source_ids":result["source_ids"],"manifest_member":result["manifest_member"],
                                 "original_manifest_sha256":result["original_manifest_sha256"],
                                 "receiving":"Reimport this complete ZIP through the original Sources workflow; retain its actual new collection receipt if its manifest filename produces a new ID."})
            atomic_json(folder/"synthesis-record.json",record)
            atomic_json(folder/"synthesis-history.json",history)
            atomic_json(folder/"source-catalog.json",catalog)
            atomic_json(folder/"original-source-archives.json",archives)
            recipe = _recipe({**record, "_history":history},archives)
            companions = [describe_file(folder,path) for path in sorted(folder.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()]
            recipe["inputs"] = [{key:row[key] for key in ("path","bytes","sha256")} for row in companions]
